scripts.title: Auto Play
scripts.author: tylenol
scripts.summary: Auto Player for Symphony Ochestra.
scripts.code:
if _G.__SYMPHONY_AP then
    local old = _G.__SYMPHONY_AP
    old.alive = false
    pcall(function() old.conn:Disconnect() end)
    pcall(function() old.win:Destroy() end)
    _G.__SYMPHONY_AP = nil
end

local Players = game:GetService('Players')
local RunService = game:GetService('RunService')
local LP = Players.LocalPlayer

local state = { alive = true, enabled = false, lastNote = {} }
_G.__SYMPHONY_AP = state

local function upsOf(f)
    local ok, ups = pcall(getupvalues, f)
    if not ok or type(ups) ~= 'table' then return nil end
    return ups
end

local engine, resolveErr = nil, nil
do
    local function isKeymap(t)
        for k in pairs(t) do
            return typeof(k) == 'EnumItem'
        end
        return false
    end

    local function validateLaneDown(f)
        if type(f) ~= 'function' then return nil end
        local ld = upsOf(f)
        if not ld or #ld < 13 then return nil end
        local Config = ld[8]
        if type(Config) ~= 'table' then return nil end
        if type(rawget(Config, 'PerfectWindow')) ~= 'number' then return nil end
        if type(rawget(Config, 'DefaultLaneKeys')) ~= 'table' then return nil end
        if type(ld[4]) ~= 'number' or type(ld[7]) ~= 'number' then return nil end
        if type(ld[10]) ~= 'table' or type(ld[2]) ~= 'table' then return nil end
        if type(ld[11]) ~= 'number' or type(ld[12]) ~= 'function' then return nil end
        return { laneDown = f, Config = Config, held = ld[2] }
    end

    local ok, res = pcall(function()
        local conns = getconnections(LP:GetAttributeChangedSignal('OrchestraPadKeys'))
        local found = nil
        for _, c in ipairs(conns) do
            if found then break end
            local u = upsOf(c.Function)
            if u and type(u[1]) == 'function' and type(u[2]) == 'boolean' and type(u[3]) == 'function' then
                local bl = upsOf(u[3])
                if bl then
                    for i = 1, #bl do
                        if found then break end
                        if type(bl[i]) == 'function' then
                            local ola = upsOf(bl[i])
                            if ola then
                                for j = 1, #ola do
                                    if found then break end
                                    if type(ola[j]) == 'function' then
                                        local hit = validateLaneDown(ola[j])
                                        if hit then
                                            local keymap
                                            for k = 1, #ola do
                                                if type(ola[k]) == 'table' and isKeymap(ola[k]) then
                                                    keymap = ola[k]
                                                end
                                            end
                                            if keymap then
                                                hit.onLaneAction = bl[i]
                                                hit.keymap = keymap
                                                found = hit
                                            end
                                        end
                                    end
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        assert(found, 'RhythmClient lane engine not found')
        return found
    end)
    if ok then engine = res else resolveErr = tostring(res) end
end
state.engine = engine

local function pressLane(lane)
    local Config = engine.Config
    local keymap = engine.keymap
    local key = Config.LaneKeys and Config.LaneKeys[lane]
    if not (key and keymap[key] == lane) then
        key = nil
        for k, v in pairs(keymap) do
            if v == lane then key = k break end
        end
    end
    if not key then return false end
    return pcall(engine.onLaneAction, nil, Enum.UserInputState.Begin, { KeyCode = key })
end

if engine then
    state.conn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
        if not state.alive then return end
        if not state.enabled then return end

        local ld = upsOf(engine.laneDown)
        if not ld then return end
        local clockOff, songStart, notes = ld[4], ld[7], ld[10]
        if type(clockOff) ~= 'number' or type(songStart) ~= 'number' or type(notes) ~= 'table' then return end
        local n = #notes
        if n == 0 then return end

        local Config = engine.Config
        local audioOff = (Config.AudioOffset or 0) + (LP:GetAttribute('OrchestraAudioOffset') or 0) / 1000
        local pos = (os.clock() + clockOff) - songStart - audioOff

        local goodWindow = (type(ld[11]) == 'number' and ld[11]) or (Config.GoodWindow or 0.12)
        local horizon = goodWindow + (Config.LateGrace or 0.05) - 0.02

        for i = 1, n do
            local note = notes[i]
            if type(note) == 'table' and not note.Judged then
                local t = note.Time
                if type(t) == 'number' then
                    local dt = pos - t
                    if dt >= 0 and dt <= horizon then
                        local lane = note.Lane
                        if type(lane) == 'number' and lane >= 1 and lane <= 4 then
                            if pressLane(lane) then
                                state.lastNote[lane] = { t = t, len = tonumber(note.Length) or 0 }
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end

        for lane, info in pairs(state.lastNote) do
            if pos > info.t + info.len + 0.06 then
                engine.held[lane] = nil
                state.lastNote[lane] = nil
            end
        end
    end)
    print('[SymphonyAP] engine hooked: laneDown/onLaneAction/note-list online')
else
    warn('[SymphonyAP] engine hook FAILED: ' .. tostring(resolveErr))
end

local function setEnabled(v)
    state.enabled = v
    if not v then state.lastNote = {} end
end

local function fallbackGui()
    local gui = Instance.new('ScreenGui')
    gui.Name = 'SymphonyAutoplay'
    gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
    gui.Parent = LP:WaitForChild('PlayerGui')
    local btn = Instance.new('TextButton')
    btn.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(150, 40)
    btn.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -75, 0, 8)
    btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40, 40, 48)
    btn.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
    btn.TextSize = 16
    btn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium
    btn.Text = 'Autoplay: OFF'
    btn.Parent = gui
    btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        setEnabled(not state.enabled)
        btn.Text = 'Autoplay: ' .. (state.enabled and 'ON' or 'OFF')
        btn.BackgroundColor3 = state.enabled and Color3.fromRGB(46, 160, 84) or Color3.fromRGB(40, 40, 48)
    end)
    state.win = { Destroy = function() gui:Destroy() end }
    print('[SymphonyAP] WindUI unavailable, using fallback toggle')
end

local windOk = pcall(function()
    local WindUI = loadstring(game:HttpGet('https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Footagesus/WindUI/main/dist/main.lua'))()
    assert(typeof(WindUI) == 'table' and WindUI.CreateWindow, 'WindUI load failed')

    local Window = WindUI:CreateWindow({
        Title = 'Symphony Autoplay',
        Icon = 'music-note-bold-duotone',
        Folder = 'SymphonyAutoplay',
        OpenButton = { Enabled = true, Title = 'Symphony Autoplay' },
    })
    state.win = Window

    local Tab = Window:Tab({ Title = 'Autoplay', Icon = 'music-note-bold-duotone' })
    Tab:Toggle({
        Title = 'Autoplay Notes',
        Desc = 'Hits every note perfectly - holds included. Start any song and watch it play itself.',
        Default = false,
        Callback = function(v)
            setEnabled(v)
            WindUI:Notify({
                Title = 'Symphony Autoplay',
                Content = v and 'Enabled - start or keep playing a song.' or 'Disabled.',
                Icon = 'music-note-bold-duotone',
                Duration = 3,
            })
        end,
    })

    WindUI:Notify({
        Title = 'Symphony Autoplay',
        Content = engine and 'Engine hooked - ready to play.' or ('Hook failed: ' .. tostring(resolveErr)),
        Icon = 'music-note-bold-duotone',
        Duration = 5,
    })
    print('[SymphonyAP] WindUI ready')
end)

if not windOk then fallbackGui() end

local function makeDraggable(frame)
	local dragging = false
	local dragInput, dragStart, startPos

	frame.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
		if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
			dragging = true
			dragStart = input.Position
			startPos = frame.Position

			input.Changed:Connect(function()
				if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then
					dragging = false
				end
			end)
		end
	end)

	frame.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
		if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
			dragInput = input
		end
	end)

	UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
		if dragging and input == dragInput then
			local delta = input.Position - dragStart
			frame.Position = UDim2.new(
				startPos.X.Scale,
				startPos.X.Offset + delta.X,
				startPos.Y.Scale,
				startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y
			)
		end
	end)
end

	if nukeEnabled then
		nukeBtn.Text = "duck nuke server: ON"
		nukeBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(28, 138, 76)
	else
		nukeBtn.Text = "duck nuke server: OFF"

local function startFireLoop(currentToken)
	task.spawn(function()
		while nukeEnabled and nukeToken == currentToken do
			local remote = getFireRemote()
			if remote then
				for _ = 1, BURST_COUNT do
					if not nukeEnabled or nukeToken ~= currentToken then
						break
					end
					triggerRemote(remote)
				end
			end
			task.wait(FIRE_INTERVAL)
		end
	end)
end

scripts.code:
--[[
	WARNING: Heads up! This script has not been verified by ScriptBlox. Use at your own risk!
]]
-- Developed for my sempai:33333333333
-- Interface: WindUI | Nome: BotPlay | Créditos: Kasana

local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
local PlayerScripts = LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerScripts")

local Client = PlayerScripts:WaitForChild("Client")
local Gameplay = Client:WaitForChild("Gameplay")
local UI = Client:WaitForChild("UI")

local Note = require(Gameplay:WaitForChild("Note"))
local Input = require(Gameplay:WaitForChild("Input"))
local Hud = require(Gameplay:WaitForChild("Hud"))
local State = require(Client:WaitForChild("Core"):WaitForChild("State"))
local Results = require(UI:WaitForChild("Screens"):WaitForChild("Results"))
local Round = require(Gameplay:WaitForChild("Round"))

if _G.FunkyDuelsCleanup then
    pcall(_G.FunkyDuelsCleanup)
end

local Config = {
    Autoplay = true,
    HitMode = "Perfect",
    LegitJitter = 12,
    AutoHold = true,

    ServerReplication = true,
    PreventMisses = true,
}

local activeHolds = {}
local handledNotes = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
local connections = {}
local originalMethods = {}

-- ============================================================
-- CACHE DE UPVALUES
-- ============================================================
local cache = {
    noteCtx = nil,
    noteCtxRound = nil,
    inputHp = nil,
    inputHr = nil,
    inputRound = nil,
}

local rawTryHitNote = Note.TryHitNote
local rawGetResults = Note.GetResults
local rawApplyGhostMiss = Note.ApplyGhostMiss
local rawSetNoteResolvedCallback = Note.SetNoteResolvedCallback

local function sanitizeInt(val, defaultVal, maxVal)
    local n = tonumber(val) or (defaultVal or 0)
    if n ~= n or n == math.huge or n == -math.huge then
        n = defaultVal or 0
    end
    return math.clamp(math.floor(n), 0, maxVal or 999999999)
end

local function refreshNoteContext()
    local ok, upvals = pcall(debug.getupvalues, rawTryHitNote)
    if not ok or not upvals then return nil end
    local ctx = {
        conductor = upvals[1],
        timingOffset = upvals[2] or 0,
        noteList = upvals[3],
        roundContext = upvals[4],
        match = upvals[5],
        hitNote = upvals[7]
    }
    cache.noteCtx = ctx
    cache.noteCtxRound = ctx.roundContext
    return ctx
end

local function getNoteContext()
    local ctx = cache.noteCtx
    if not ctx
        or ctx.roundContext ~= cache.noteCtxRound
        or not ctx.noteList
        or not ctx.conductor
        or not ctx.roundContext then
        return refreshNoteContext()
    end
    return ctx
end

local function refreshInputHandlers(roundCtx)
    local ok, upvals = pcall(debug.getupvalues, Input.Init)
    if not ok or not upvals then return end
    local bindKb = upvals[8]
    if not bindKb then return end
    local ok2, inner = pcall(debug.getupvalues, bindKb)
    if not ok2 or not inner then return end
    cache.inputHp = inner[5]
    cache.inputHr = inner[6]
    cache.inputRound = roundCtx
end

local function getInputHandlers(roundCtx)
    if cache.inputRound ~= roundCtx or not cache.inputHp then
        refreshInputHandlers(roundCtx)
    end
    return cache.inputHp, cache.inputHr
end

local function isLocalNote(note, context)
    if not context or not context.SessionLocalSide then
        return note.IsPlayer == true
    end
    return (note.IsPlayer == false) == (context.SessionLocalSide == "Left")
end

-- ============================================================
-- SAFE SET COUNT
-- ============================================================
local showStats = debug.getupvalues(Results.Show)[1]
local origSetCount = debug.getupvalues(showStats)[2]
local u63 = debug.getupvalues(origSetCount)[1]

local function safeSetCount(frame, count)
    if not frame or not frame:FindFirstChild("Index") then return end
    local Index = frame.Index

    for _, c in ipairs(frame:GetChildren()) do
        if c ~= Index and not c:IsA("UIListLayout") then
            c:Destroy()
        end
    end

    Index.Visible = false
    local num = sanitizeInt(count, 0, 999999999)
    local str = string.format("%d", num)

    for i = 1, #str do
        local digit = tonumber(str:sub(i, i))
        if digit and u63[digit + 1] and u63[digit + 1][1] then
            local clone = Index:Clone()
            clone.LayoutOrder = i
            clone.Visible = true
            clone.Image = u63[digit + 1][1].assetId
            clone.Parent = frame
        end
    end
end

debug.setupvalue(showStats, 2, safeSetCount)
debug.setupvalue(Results.Show, 3, safeSetCount)

-- ============================================================
-- HOOKS
-- ============================================================
originalMethods.SetNoteResolvedCallback = rawSetNoteResolvedCallback
Note.SetNoteResolvedCallback = function(callback)
    local wrappedCallback = function(target, count, isHit, dir, noteData)
        if target == "player" and Config.ServerReplication then
            if noteData then
                noteData.ResolvedSongTimeMs = noteData.TimeMs
            end
            if Config.PreventMisses then
                isHit = true
            end
        end
        return callback(target, count, isHit, dir, noteData)
    end
    return rawSetNoteResolvedCallback(wrappedCallback)
end

originalMethods.ApplyGhostMiss = rawApplyGhostMiss
Note.ApplyGhostMiss = function(dir)
    if Config.PreventMisses then
        return false
    end
    return rawApplyGhostMiss(dir)
end

originalMethods.Show = Results.Show
Results.Show = function(pStats, songName, diff, oppStats, isSolo)
    local success = pcall(function()
        originalMethods.Show(pStats, songName, diff, oppStats, isSolo)
    end)

    if not success then
        pcall(function()
            local up = debug.getupvalues(originalMethods.Show)
            if up[13] then up[13].Visible = true end
        end)
    end
end

-- ============================================================
-- WATCHDOG (throttled ~10Hz)
-- ============================================================
local onSongEnded = debug.getupvalues(Round.StartRound)[35]
local songEndWatchdogTriggered = false
local lastActiveNoteTime = 0
local watchdogTick = 0

local function checkSongEndWatchdog(liveSongTime, noteList, roundContext)
    if songEndWatchdogTriggered then return end
    if Results.IsVisible() then return end
    if not roundContext or roundContext.RoundOver then return end

    local hasUnresolvedNotes = false
    local maxTime = 0
    local n = #noteList

    for i = 1, n do
        local note = noteList[i]
        if not note.Hit and not note.Missed then
            hasUnresolvedNotes = true
        end
        local t = note.TimeMs
        if t and t > maxTime then
            maxTime = t
        end
    end

    if maxTime > 0 then
        lastActiveNoteTime = maxTime
    end

    if not hasUnresolvedNotes and lastActiveNoteTime > 0 and liveSongTime >= lastActiveNoteTime + 2500 then
        songEndWatchdogTriggered = true
        task.defer(function()
            if onSongEnded and not Results.IsVisible() and not roundContext.RoundOver then
                pcall(onSongEnded)
            end
        end)
    end
end

-- ============================================================
-- HEARTBEAT
-- ============================================================
local function onHeartbeat()
    if State.GetState() ~= "InGame" then
        table.clear(activeHolds)
        table.clear(handledNotes)
        songEndWatchdogTriggered = false
        lastActiveNoteTime = 0
        watchdogTick = 0
        cache.noteCtx = nil
        cache.noteCtxRound = nil
        cache.inputHp = nil
        cache.inputHr = nil
        cache.inputRound = nil
        return
    end

    local ctx = getNoteContext()
    if not ctx or not ctx.conductor or type(ctx.conductor.GetLiveSongTimeMs) ~= "function" or not ctx.noteList or not ctx.roundContext then return end
    if ctx.roundContext.RoundOver or Note.IsPaused() then return end

    local liveSongTime = ctx.conductor.GetLiveSongTimeMs() + ctx.timingOffset

    watchdogTick = watchdogTick + 1
    if watchdogTick >= 6 then
        watchdogTick = 0
        checkSongEndWatchdog(liveSongTime, ctx.noteList, ctx.roundContext)
    end

    if not Config.Autoplay then return end

    local hp, hr = getInputHandlers(ctx.roundContext)

    if Config.AutoHold then
        for dir, hold in pairs(activeHolds) do
            if liveSongTime >= hold.endTime - 8 then
                if hr then hr(dir) end
                activeHolds[dir] = nil
            end
        end
    end

    local noteList = ctx.noteList
    local count = #noteList
    local hitMode = Config.HitMode
    local legitJitter = Config.LegitJitter
    local serverRepl = Config.ServerReplication

    for i = 1, count do
        local note = noteList[i]
        if not note.Hit and not note.Missed and not handledNotes[note] then
            if isLocalNote(note, ctx.roundContext) then

                local jitter = 0
                if hitMode == "Legit" then
                    if not note._jitter then
                        note._jitter = math.random(-legitJitter, legitJitter)
                    end
                    jitter = note._jitter
                end

                local targetHitTime = note.TimeMs + jitter

                if liveSongTime >= targetHitTime then
                    handledNotes[note] = true

                    if serverRepl then
                        note.ResolvedSongTimeMs = note.TimeMs
                    end

                    if hp then hp(note.Dir) end
                    if not note.Hit then rawTryHitNote(note.Dir) end

                    if note.HoldMs and note.HoldMs > 0 then
                        activeHolds[note.Dir] = {
                            dir = note.Dir,
                            endTime = note.TimeMs + note.HoldMs
                        }
                    else
                        task.delay(0.045 + math.random() * 0.015, function()
                            if hr and not activeHolds[note.Dir] then
                                hr(note.Dir)
                            end
                        end)
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end

    if count == 0 and next(handledNotes) ~= nil then
        table.clear(handledNotes)
    end
end

table.insert(connections, RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(onHeartbeat))

do
	local dragging = false
	local dragStart = Vector2.zero
	local startPos = UDim2.zero

	TopBar.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
		if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
			dragging = true
			dragStart = Vector2.new(input.Position.X, input.Position.Y)
			startPos = MainFrame.Position
		end
	end)

	UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
		if dragging and (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
			local delta = Vector2.new(input.Position.X, input.Position.Y) - dragStart
			MainFrame.Position = UDim2.new(
				startPos.X.Scale,
				startPos.X.Offset + delta.X,
				startPos.Y.Scale,
				startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y
			)
		end
	end)

	UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
		if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
			dragging = false
		end
	end)
end

-- Przeciąganie strzałki/kursora + kliknięcie w celu powrotu do menu
do
	local dragging = false
	local moved = false

	local startPos = UDim2.zero

	ReopenCursorBtn.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
		if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
			dragging = true
			moved = false
			dragStart = Vector2.new(input.Position.X, input.Position.Y)
			startPos = ReopenCursorBtn.Position
		end
	end)

	UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
		if dragging and (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
			local delta = Vector2.new(input.Position.X, input.Position.Y) - dragStart
			if delta.Magnitude > 5 then
				moved = true
			end
			ReopenCursorBtn.Position = UDim2.new(
				startPos.X.Scale,
				startPos.X.Offset + delta.X,
				startPos.Y.Scale,
				startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y
			)
		end
	end)

	UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
		if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
			if dragging and not moved then
				MainFrame.Visible = true
				ReopenCursorBtn.Visible = false
			end
			dragging = false
		end
	end)
end

local function restoreCharacterMovement(char)
	local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera

		cam.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Custom
	end

	if not char then
		return
	end
	local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if hum then
		hum.PlatformStand = false
		hum.Sit = false
		hum.AutoRotate = true
		hum.WalkSpeed = speedEnabled and targetWalkSpeed or defaultWalkSpeed
		if cam then
			cam.CameraSubject = hum
		end
	end

	for _, part in ipairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
		if part:IsA("BasePart") then
			part.Anchored = false
			if not noClipEnabled then
				if part.Name == "HumanoidRootPart" then

				end
			end
		end
	end
end

	end

-- Odczyt Ping w ms ze statystyk sieciowych
local function getPingMs()
	local pingMs = 0
	pcall(function()
		local netStats = Stats:FindFirstChild("Network")
		local serverStats = netStats and netStats:FindFirstChild("ServerStatsItem")
		local dataPing = serverStats and serverStats:FindFirstChild("Data Ping")
		if dataPing and typeof(dataPing.GetValue) == "function" then
			pingMs = math.floor(dataPing:GetValue() + 0.5)
		end
	end)
	return pingMs
end

-- Sprawdza, czy między kamerą a celem nie ma ściany ani przeszkody
local function isTargetVisible(camera, targetCharacter, targetPart)
	local origin = camera.CFrame.Position
	local direction = targetPart.Position - origin
	local distance = direction.Magnitude
	if distance <= 0.5 then
		return true
	end

	local params = RaycastParams.new()
	params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
	local ignoreList = {}
	if LocalPlayer.Character then
		table.insert(ignoreList, LocalPlayer.Character)
	end
	if targetCharacter then
		table.insert(ignoreList, targetCharacter)
	end
	params.FilterDescendantsInstances = ignoreList
	params.IgnoreWater = true

	local result = workspace:Raycast(origin, direction.Unit * distance, params)
	if not result then
		return true
	end

	return result.Instance:IsDescendantOf(targetCharacter)
end

local lockedPlayer = nil

local function isPlayerValidTarget(plr, camera, checkFov, allowWalls)
	if not plr or plr == LocalPlayer or not plr.Character then
		return false, nil
	end
	if isTeammate(plr) then
		return false, nil
	end

	local hum = plr.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	local part = getAimPartForCharacter(plr.Character)
	if not hum or hum.Health <= 0 or not part then
		return false, nil
	end

	local screenPos, onScreen = camera:WorldToViewportPoint(part.Position)
	if not onScreen or screenPos.Z <= 0 then
		return false, nil
	end

	if checkFov then
		local center = Vector2.new(camera.ViewportSize.X * 0.5, camera.ViewportSize.Y * 0.5)
		local distFromCenter = (Vector2.new(screenPos.X, screenPos.Y) - center).Magnitude
		if distFromCenter > fovRadius then
			return false, nil
		end
	end

	if not allowWalls and not isTargetVisible(camera, plr.Character, part) then
		return false, nil
	end

	return true, part
end

-- Wybór celu z obsługą Auto Target Lock, Team Check, Head/Torso oraz Wall Bang
local function resolveAimTarget(camera, checkFov, allowWalls)
	if autoTargetLockEnabled and lockedPlayer then
		local valid, lockedPart = isPlayerValidTarget(lockedPlayer, camera, checkFov, allowWalls)
		if valid and lockedPart then
			return lockedPart
		end
		lockedPlayer = nil
	end

	local center = Vector2.new(camera.ViewportSize.X * 0.5, camera.ViewportSize.Y * 0.5)
	local bestPart = nil
	local bestPlr = nil
	local bestDist = checkFov and fovRadius or math.huge

	for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		local valid, part = isPlayerValidTarget(plr, camera, checkFov, allowWalls)
		if valid and part then
			local screenPos = camera:WorldToViewportPoint(part.Position)
			local distFromCenter = (Vector2.new(screenPos.X, screenPos.Y) - center).Magnitude
			if distFromCenter <= bestDist then
				bestDist = distFromCenter
				bestPart = part
				bestPlr = plr
			end
		end
	end

	if autoTargetLockEnabled and bestPlr then
		lockedPlayer = bestPlr
	end

	return bestPart
end

-- Szuka najbliższego żywego przeciwnika pod Auto Win (z uwzględnieniem Team Check)
local function getNextAutoWinTarget(myRoot)
	local closestRoot = nil
	local closestAimPart = nil
	local shortest = math.huge

	for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		if plr ~= LocalPlayer and not isTeammate(plr) and plr.Character then
			local char = plr.Character
			local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
			local root = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			local aimPart = getAimPartForCharacter(char)
			if hum and hum.Health > 0 and root and aimPart then
				local dist = myRoot and (myRoot.Position - root.Position).Magnitude or 0
				if dist < shortest then
					shortest = dist
					closestRoot = root
					closestAimPart = aimPart
				end
			end
		end
	end

	return closestRoot, closestAimPart
end

-- Gdy Shoot Walls jest włączone: na ułamek sekundy (bez ruszania obrazu kamery) przenosi postać za cel, strzela i wraca
local silentBackTpBusy = false

local function triggerShot(myChar, explicitTargetPart)
	local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
	local myRoot = myChar and myChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	local myHum = myChar and myChar:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")

	if shootThroughWallsEnabled and not autoWinEnabled and not silentBackTpBusy and camera and myRoot and myHum and myHum.Health > 0 then
		local targetPart = explicitTargetPart or resolveAimTarget(camera, false, true)
		local targetChar = targetPart and targetPart.Parent
		local targetRoot = targetChar and (targetChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or targetPart)

		if targetPart and targetRoot then
			silentBackTpBusy = true

			local savedRootCFrame = myRoot.CFrame
			local savedCamCFrame = camera.CFrame
			local savedCamType = camera.CameraType

			-- Zamrażamy wizualny widok kamery w miejscu, w którym stoisz, żebyś nie widział skoku
			camera.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Scriptable
			camera.CFrame = savedCamCFrame

			local behindPos = targetRoot.Position - (targetRoot.CFrame.LookVector * 3.4) + Vector3.new(0, 0.5, 0)
			myRoot.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(behindPos, targetPart.Position)

			fireWeaponRaw(myChar)

			task.defer(function()
				RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
				if myRoot and myRoot.Parent then
					myRoot.CFrame = savedRootCFrame
				end
				if camera then
					camera.CameraType = savedCamType
					if savedCamType == Enum.CameraType.Custom then
						camera.CFrame = savedCamCFrame
					end
				end
				silentBackTpBusy = false
			end)
			return
		end
	end

	fireWeaponRaw(myChar)
end

local lastAimbotShot = 0
local lastAutoWinShot = 0
local lastRageShot = 0
local lastStatsUpdate = 0
local frameCount = 0
local currentFps = 60

local conn
conn = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt)
	local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
	if not camera or not ScreenGui.Parent then
		return
	end

	frameCount += 1
	local now = os.clock()
	if (now - lastStatsUpdate) >= 0.25 then
		local elapsed = now - lastStatsUpdate
		currentFps = math.floor((frameCount / math.max(0.001, elapsed)) + 0.5)
		frameCount = 0
		lastStatsUpdate = now

		local ping = getPingMs()
		BottomRightStats.Text = string.format("FPS: %d | Ping: %d | %d ms", currentFps, ping, ping)
	end

	local myChar = LocalPlayer.Character
	local myRoot = myChar and myChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	local myHum = myChar and myChar:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")

	-- Speed ustawiony na 50 (WalkSpeed + płynny bieg w kierunku MoveDirection, bez blokowania ruchu)
	if myHum then
		local desiredSpeed = speedEnabled and targetWalkSpeed or defaultWalkSpeed
		if myHum.WalkSpeed ~= desiredSpeed then
			myHum.WalkSpeed = desiredSpeed
		end
		if speedEnabled and myRoot and myHum.MoveDirection.Magnitude > 0.05 and not autoWinEnabled then
			local extraSpeed = math.max(0, targetWalkSpeed - defaultWalkSpeed)
			local deltaMove = myHum.MoveDirection.Unit * extraSpeed * math.min(dt, 0.05)
			myRoot.CFrame = myRoot.CFrame + deltaMove
		end
	end

	-- Gdy wyłączysz Auto Win, natychmiast przywróć normalne chodzenie i kamerę
	if not autoWinEnabled and autoWinActiveLastFrame then
		autoWinActiveLastFrame = false
		restoreCharacterMovement(myChar)
	end

	-- Gdy masz włączone Shoot Walls i sam trzymasz strzał podczas normalnego chodzenia
	if shootThroughWallsEnabled and firingHeld and not aimbotEnabled and not rageBotEnabled and not silentAimEnabled and myHum and myHum.Health > 0 then
		if (now - lastManualShootWallsShot) >= fireDelay then
			lastManualShootWallsShot = now
			local targetPart = resolveAimTarget(camera, false, true)
			triggerShot(myChar, targetPart)
		end
	end

	-- Aktualizacja ESP
	for plr, data in pairs(playerEsp) do
		if not espEnabled then
			data.holder.Visible = false
		else
			local char = plr.Character
			local root = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")

			if char and root and hum and hum.Health > 0 and myRoot then
				local rootScreen, onScreen = camera:WorldToViewportPoint(root.Position)
				if onScreen and rootScreen.Z > 0 then
					local topScreen = camera:WorldToViewportPoint(root.Position + Vector3.new(0, 2.8, 0))
					local bottomScreen = camera:WorldToViewportPoint(root.Position - Vector3.new(0, 3.2, 0))

					local boxSize = math.clamp(math.abs(bottomScreen.Y - topScreen.Y), 16, 260)
					local cx = rootScreen.X
					local cy = (topScreen.Y + bottomScreen.Y) * 0.5

					data.holder.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 0)
					data.holder.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(camera.ViewportSize.X, camera.ViewportSize.Y)
					data.holder.Visible = true

					data.squareBox.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(boxSize, boxSize)
					data.squareBox.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(cx - boxSize * 0.5, cy - boxSize * 0.5)

					local hp = math.floor(hum.Health + 0.5)
					local maxHp = math.max(1, math.floor(hum.MaxHealth + 0.5))
					data.topLabel.Text = string.format("%s | HP: %d/%d", plr.Name, hp, maxHp)
					data.topLabel.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(220, 16)
					data.topLabel.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(cx - 110, cy - boxSize * 0.5 - 19)

					local studs = math.floor((myRoot.Position - root.Position).Magnitude + 0.5)
					data.distLabel.Text = tostring(studs) .. " studs"
					data.distLabel.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(140, 15)
					data.distLabel.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(cx - 70, cy + boxSize * 0.5 + 3)
				else
					data.holder.Visible = false
				end
			else
				data.holder.Visible = false
			end
		end
	end

	-- Auto Win: teleportuje na bezpieczny dystans za żywym celem w każdej rundzie, celuje i strzela bez kursorów myszy na mobile
	if autoWinEnabled and myRoot and myHum and myHum.Health > 0 then
		autoWinActiveLastFrame = true
		local targetRoot, targetAimPart = getNextAutoWinTarget(myRoot)
		if targetRoot and targetAimPart then
			local standPos = targetRoot.Position - (targetRoot.CFrame.LookVector * 3.8) + Vector3.new(0, 1.0, 0)
			myRoot.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(standPos, Vector3.new(targetAimPart.Position.X, standPos.Y, targetAimPart.Position.Z))
			if camera.CameraType == Enum.CameraType.Custom then
				camera.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(camera.CFrame.Position, targetAimPart.Position)
			end

			local stepDelay = math.max(0.05, fireDelay)
			if (now - lastAutoWinShot) >= stepDelay then
				lastAutoWinShot = now
				fireWeaponRaw(myChar)
			end
		else
			restoreCharacterMovement(myChar)
		end
	end

	-- Rage Bot: celuje w przeciwnika i strzela bez blokowania chodzenia
	if rageBotEnabled and myHum and myHum.Health > 0 then
		local rageTarget = resolveAimTarget(camera, false, wallBangEnabled)
		if rageTarget then
			if camera.CameraType == Enum.CameraType.Custom and not silentBackTpBusy then
				camera.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(camera.CFrame.Position, rageTarget.Position)
			end
			if (now - lastRageShot) >= fireDelay then
				lastRageShot = now
				triggerShot(myChar, rageTarget)
			end
		end
	end

	-- Aktualizacja Aimbot (czerwone kółko FOV do 650, z Wall Bang + Head/Torso)
	if aimbotEnabled then
		FovCircle.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(camera.ViewportSize.X * 0.5, camera.ViewportSize.Y * 0.5)
		FovCircle.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(fovRadius * 2, fovRadius * 2)
		FovCircle.Visible = true

		local targetPart = resolveAimTarget(camera, true, wallBangEnabled)
		if targetPart then
			if camera.CameraType == Enum.CameraType.Custom and not silentBackTpBusy then
				camera.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(camera.CFrame.Position, targetPart.Position)
			end
			if (now - lastAimbotShot) >= fireDelay then
				lastAimbotShot = now
				triggerShot(myChar, targetPart)
			end
		end
	else
		FovCircle.Visible = false
	end

	-- Silent Aim: przy strzale namierza cel na moment strzału i wraca
	if silentAimEnabled and firingHeld then
		local targetPart = resolveAimTarget(camera, false, wallBangEnabled)
		if targetPart and (now - lastSilentShot) >= fireDelay then
			lastSilentShot = now
			local oldCam = camera.CFrame
			if camera.CameraType == Enum.CameraType.Custom and not silentBackTpBusy then
				camera.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(oldCam.Position, targetPart.Position)
			end
			triggerShot(myChar, targetPart)
			if camera.CameraType == Enum.CameraType.Custom and not silentBackTpBusy then
				camera.CFrame = oldCam
			end
		end
	end
end)

scripts.author: TarzanJungleMan
scripts.summary: # SynaptaHub Webhook Spy A Roblox executor script that intercepts, logs, and optionally blocks outbound HTTP traffic with special focus on catching Discord webhooks used by malicious scripts. ## Features - **Traffic Interception** — Hook…
scripts.code:
local OrionLib = loadstring(game:HttpGet("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jensonhirst/Orion/main/source"))()
local HttpService = game:GetService("HttpService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer

local genv = (getgenv and getgenv()) or _G

-- Clipboard fallback with debug
local setclipboard = setclipboard
    or genv.setclipboard
    or (syn and syn.set_clipboard)
    or (fluxus and fluxus.set_clipboard)
    or (krnl and krnl.set_clipboard)
    or function(text)
        warn("No clipboard function available – cannot copy: " .. tostring(text):sub(1, 50))
    end

-- [[ Configuration States ]]
local isScanning = true
local logAllTraffic = false
local logHttpGet = true
local blockWebhooks = false
local blockAllTraffic = false

-- [[ Data Logging Storage ]]
local requestHistory = {}
local lastCopiedCount = 0
local webhookDomains = {
    "discord%.com/api/webhooks",
    "discordapp%.com/api/webhooks",
    "hooks%.discord%.com",
    "ptb%.discord%.com/api/webhooks",
    "canary%.discord%.com/api/webhooks"
}

-- Flags for tests
local kickHooked = false
local wsConnectedHooked = false

-- [[ Helper Functions ]]
local function checkWebhook(url)
    if not url then return false end
    local lowerUrl = string.lower(tostring(url))
    for _, pattern in ipairs(webhookDomains) do
        if string.find(lowerUrl, pattern) then
            return true
        end
    end
    return false
end

local function compileReport()
    if #requestHistory == 0 then return nil end
    local outputReport = "=== SynaptaHub WEBHOOK SPY TRAFFIC REPORT ===\n"
    outputReport = outputReport .. "Total Captured Packets: " .. tostring(#requestHistory) .. "\n\n"
    for index, data in ipairs(requestHistory) do
        outputReport = outputReport .. string.format(
            "[%d] [%s] %s\n• URL: %s\n• Method: %s\n• Headers: %s\n• Body: %s\n\n",
            index, data.Time, data.Type, data.Url, data.Method, data.Headers, data.Body
        )
    end
    outputReport = outputReport .. "=== END OF REPORT ==="
    return outputReport
end

local function emergencyClipboardSave()
    local report = compileReport()
    if report then
        local ok, err = pcall(setclipboard, report)
        if not ok then
            warn("Failed to save logs to clipboard: " .. tostring(err))
        end
        OrionLib:MakeNotification({
            Name = "🔒 Logs Auto‑Saved",
            Content = "All captured traffic copied to clipboard before disconnection.",
            Time = 5
        })
    end
end

-- [[ Exit & Kick Protection ]]
if hookfunction then
    local oldKick
    oldKick = hookfunction(LocalPlayer.Kick, newcclosure(function(self, ...)
        emergencyClipboardSave()
        OrionLib:MakeNotification({
            Name = "🛡️ Kick Prevented",
            Content = "A script attempted to kick you. Logs saved to clipboard.",
            Time = 5
        })
        return oldKick(self, ...)
    end))
    kickHooked = true
end

Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
    if player == LocalPlayer then
        emergencyClipboardSave()
    end
end)

-- ============================================================
--  LOG QUEUE – decouples logging from the hook to prevent freezing
-- ============================================================
local logQueue = {}
local queueProcessing = false

local function enqueueLog(item)
    table.insert(logQueue, item)
    if not queueProcessing then
        queueProcessing = true
        task.spawn(function()
            while #logQueue > 0 do
                local current = table.remove(logQueue, 1)
                if current then
                    table.insert(requestHistory, current)
                    if current.Type == "DISCORD WEBHOOK" or string.find(string.lower(current.Url), "webhook") then
                        print("\n=== [WEBHOOK] ===")
                        print("Time:", current.Time)
                        print("URL:", current.Url)
                        print("Method:", current.Method)
                        print("==================\n")
                    end
                end
                task.wait(0.02)
            end
            queueProcessing = false
        end)
    end
end

local function processLog(url, method, headers, body, customType)
    if not isScanning then return false end

    local isWebhook = checkWebhook(url)
    local isHttpGetCall = (customType == "HTTP GET") or (customType == "DataModel_HttpGet") or (method == "HttpGet")

    if not (isWebhook or logAllTraffic or (isHttpGetCall and logHttpGet)) then
        return false
    end

    local logEntry = {
        Time = os.date("%X"),
        Type = customType or (isWebhook and "DISCORD WEBHOOK" or "STANDARD HTTP"),
        Url = tostring(url or "Unknown"),
        Method = tostring(method or "GET"),
        Headers = headers and (type(headers) == "table" and HttpService:JSONEncode(headers) or tostring(headers)) or "None",
        Body = body and tostring(body) or "None"
    }

    enqueueLog(logEntry)

    if isWebhook then
        OrionLib:MakeNotification({
            Name = "⚠️ Webhook Intercepted!",
            Content = (blockAllTraffic or blockWebhooks) and "Blocked webhook request!" or "Logged webhook request.",
            Time = 2
        })
    elseif blockAllTraffic then
        OrionLib:MakeNotification({
            Name = "🛑 Request Blocked",
            Content = "Blocked outgoing " .. logEntry.Method .. " to " .. logEntry.Url:sub(1, 30) .. "...",
            Time = 2
        })
    end

    return isWebhook
end

-- ============================================================
--  STEALTH INTERCEPTION: __namecall hook on the DataModel
-- ============================================================
local gameMeta = getrawmetatable(game)
if gameMeta then
    local oldNamecall = gameMeta.__namecall

    local function namecallHook(self, ...)
        local method = getnamecallmethod()
        if method and (method == "HttpGet" or method == "HttpPost" or method == "HttpPostAsync" or method == "HttpRequest") then
            local url = ...
            local isWebhook = checkWebhook(url)

            processLog(url, method, nil, nil, "DataModel_" .. method)

            if blockAllTraffic or (isWebhook and blockWebhooks) then
                if method == "HttpGet" then
                    return ""
                else
                    return { StatusCode = 403, Body = "Blocked by SynaptaHub", Success = false }
                end
            end
        end

        if oldNamecall then
            return oldNamecall(self, ...)
        elseif gameMeta.__index then
            local idx = gameMeta.__index(self, method)
            if type(idx) == "function" then
                return idx(self, ...)
            end
        end
    end

    local wasReadonly = false
    if isreadonly and setreadonly then
        wasReadonly = isreadonly(gameMeta)
        if wasReadonly then
            setreadonly(gameMeta, false)
        end
    end

    gameMeta.__namecall = newcclosure(namecallHook)

    if wasReadonly and setreadonly then
        setreadonly(gameMeta, true)
    end
end

-- [[ Hook global request functions ]]
local hookedFuncs = {}

local function hookHttpFunction(targetFunc)
    if not targetFunc or type(targetFunc) ~= "function" or hookedFuncs[targetFunc] then
        return
    end
    hookedFuncs[targetFunc] = true

    local oldFunc
    oldFunc = hookfunction(targetFunc, newcclosure(function(options)
        if type(options) == "string" then
            options = { Url = options, Method = "GET" }
        end

        if type(options) == "table" and options.Url then
            local isWebhook = processLog(options.Url, options.Method, options.Headers, options.Body, "REQUEST")

            if blockAllTraffic or (isWebhook and blockWebhooks) then
                return {
                    StatusCode = 403,
                    Body = "Blocked by SynaptaHub Webhook Spy",
                    Success = false,
                    StatusMessage = "Forbidden"
                }
            end
        end

        return oldFunc(options)
    end))
end

local requestTargets = {
    request,
    http_request,
    genv.request,
    genv.http_request,
    (syn and syn.request),
    (fluxus and fluxus.request),
    (http and http.request),
    (krnl and krnl.request),
    (executor and executor.request)
}

for _, fn in ipairs(requestTargets) do
    hookHttpFunction(fn)
end

-- [[ Hook WebSocket.connect ]]
local wsLib = WebSocket or genv.WebSocket or ws or genv.ws
if wsLib and type(wsLib.connect) == "function" then
    local oldWSConnect
    oldWSConnect = hookfunction(wsLib.connect, newcclosure(function(url)
        processLog(url, "WS_CONNECT", nil, nil, "WEBSOCKET")
        if blockAllTraffic then
            error("WebSocket connection blocked by Webhook Spy")
        end
        return oldWSConnect(url)
    end))
    wsConnectedHooked = true
end

-- ============================================================
--  UI INITIALIZATION
-- ============================================================
local Window = OrionLib:MakeWindow({
    Name = "SynaptaHub Webhook Spy",
    HidePremium = false,
    SaveConfig = true,
    ConfigFolder = "ProxyPro"
})

local SpyTab = Window:MakeTab({Name = "Webhook Spy", Icon = "rbxassetid://4483345998", PremiumOnly = false})

SpyTab:AddParagraph("Advanced HTTP Interceptor", "Hooks request functions, HttpGet, and WebSockets for traffic inspection.")

-- [[ Controls ]]
SpyTab:AddToggle({
    Name = "Enable Scanner (Continuous)",
    Default = isScanning,
    Callback = function(state)
        isScanning = state
        OrionLib:MakeNotification({
            Name = "Scanner Status",
            Content = state and "Monitoring active..." or "Monitoring suspended.",
            Time = 3
        })
    end
})

SpyTab:AddToggle({
    Name = "Log ALL Non-Webhook HTTP Traffic",
    Default = logAllTraffic,
    Callback = function(state)
        logAllTraffic = state
    end
})

SpyTab:AddToggle({
    Name = "Log HttpGet Calls",
    Default = logHttpGet,
    Callback = function(state)
        logHttpGet = state
    end
})

SpyTab:AddToggle({
    Name = "Block Intercepted Webhooks",
    Default = blockWebhooks,
    Callback = function(state)
        blockWebhooks = state
        OrionLib:MakeNotification({
            Name = "Webhook Protection",
            Content = state and "Discord webhooks will now be dropped." or "Webhook blocking disabled.",
            Time = 3
        })
    end
})

SpyTab:AddToggle({
    Name = "Block All Intercepted Traffic",
    Default = blockAllTraffic,
    Callback = function(state)
        blockAllTraffic = state
        OrionLib:MakeNotification({
            Name = "Traffic Firewall",
            Content = state and "ALL outbound requests will be blocked!" or "Outbound requests allowed.",
            Time = 3
        })
    end
})

-- [[ Data Control Actions ]]
SpyTab:AddButton({
    Name = "Copy All Logs to Clipboard",
    Callback = function()
        local report = compileReport()
        if not report then
            OrionLib:MakeNotification({
                Name = "Clipboard Action",
                Content = "No logs captured yet!",
                Time = 3
            })
            return
        end

        local ok, err = pcall(setclipboard, report)
        if not ok then
            OrionLib:MakeNotification({
                Name = "Clipboard Error",
                Content = "Failed to copy: " .. tostring(err),
                Time = 4
            })
            return
        end
        OrionLib:MakeNotification({
            Name = "Success!",
            Content = tostring(#requestHistory) .. " logs compiled and copied to clipboard.",
            Time = 5
        })
    end
})

SpyTab:AddButton({
    Name = "Clear Interception History",
    Callback = function()
        requestHistory = {}
        lastCopiedCount = 0
        OrionLib:MakeNotification({
            Name = "History Status",
            Content = "Stored internal traffic data cleared.",
            Time = 3
        })
    end
})

-- ============================================================
--  FIXED AUTO-COPY TOGGLE
-- ============================================================
local autoCopyActive = false
local autoCopyThread = nil

SpyTab:AddToggle({
    Name = "🔁 Auto-Copy Logs to Clipboard (every 1s)",
    Default = false,
    Callback = function(state)
        autoCopyActive = state
        if state then
            if autoCopyThread then
                task.cancel(autoCopyThread)
            end
            OrionLib:MakeNotification({
                Name = "Auto-Copy Started",
                Content = "Logs will be copied to clipboard every second.",
                Time = 3
            })
            autoCopyThread = task.spawn(function()
                print("[Auto-Copy] Thread started")
                while autoCopyActive do
                    local report = compileReport()
                    if report and #requestHistory > lastCopiedCount then
                        local ok, err = pcall(setclipboard, report)
                        if ok then
                            lastCopiedCount = #requestHistory
                            print(string.format("[Auto-Copy] Copied %d logs at %s", lastCopiedCount, os.date("%X")))
                            OrionLib:MakeNotification({
                                Name = "📋 Auto-Copy",
                                Content = string.format("Copied %d logs to clipboard", lastCopiedCount),
                                Time = 1
                            })
                        else
                            warn("[Auto-Copy] Failed to copy: " .. tostring(err))
                        end
                    end
                    task.wait(1)
                end
                print("[Auto-Copy] Thread stopped")
            end)
        else
            if autoCopyThread then
                task.cancel(autoCopyThread)
                autoCopyThread = nil
            end
            lastCopiedCount = 0
            OrionLib:MakeNotification({
                Name = "Auto-Copy Stopped",
                Content = "Auto-copy of logs disabled.",
                Time = 2
            })
        end
    end
})

-- [[ Test suite & copy results ]]
local testResultsOutput = ""

SpyTab:AddButton({
    Name = "⚡ Run Full Protection Test Suite",
    Callback = function()
        OrionLib:MakeNotification({
            Name = "Test Environment",
            Content = "Running SynaptaHub Interception Tests...",
            Time = 3
        })

        task.spawn(function()
            local testResultLines = {}
            local function addResultLine(line)
                table.insert(testResultLines, line)
                print(line)
            end

            local passed, failed, skipped = 0, 0, 0
            local startTime = tick()

            local function test(name, fn)
                local startTestTime = tick()
                local ok, result = pcall(fn)
                local duration = math.floor((tick() - startTestTime) * 1000)

                if ok and result ~= false then
                    passed = passed + 1
                    addResultLine(string.format("  [✅ PASS] %-40s (%dms)", name, duration))
                else
                    failed = failed + 1
                    addResultLine(string.format("  [❌ FAIL] %-40s (%dms) -> %s", name, duration, tostring(result)))
                end
            end

            local function skip(name, reason)
                skipped = skipped + 1
                addResultLine(string.format("  [⚠️ SKIP] %-40s -> %s", name, reason))
            end

            addResultLine("\n============================================================")
            addResultLine("      SYNAPTAHUB – FULL PROTECTION TEST SUITE               ")
            addResultLine("============================================================")

            -- Category 1: Stealth
            addResultLine("\n┌── [ CATEGORY: Stealth & Anti-Detection ] ────────────────┐")
            test("game.HttpGet is still a C closure", function()
                return iscclosure and iscclosure(game.HttpGet) == true
            end)

            test("game.HttpGet debug info shows 'C'", function()
                if not debug or not debug.getinfo then return false end
                local info = debug.getinfo(game.HttpGet)
                return info and info.what == "C"
            end)

            test("__namecall hook is installed correctly", function()
                local meta = getrawmetatable(game)
                return meta and meta.__namecall ~= nil
            end)

            test("Raw __index returns the same HttpGet function", function()
                local meta = getrawmetatable(game)
                if not meta or not meta.__index then return false end
                local rawHttpGet = meta.__index(game, "HttpGet")
                return rawHttpGet == game.HttpGet
            end)

            -- Category 2: Logging
            addResultLine("\n┌── [ CATEGORY: Logging & Interception ] ──────────────────┐")
            local function clearLogs()
                requestHistory = {}
                lastCopiedCount = 0
            end
            clearLogs()

            test("Logging of non-webhook GET request (via game:HttpGet)", function()
                clearLogs()
                local _ = game:HttpGet("https://httpbin.org/get")
                task.wait(0.1)
                return #requestHistory >= 1
            end)

            test("Logging of webhook request (via game:HttpGet)", function()
                clearLogs()
                local _ = game:HttpGet("https://discord.com/api/webhooks/123/abc")
                task.wait(0.1)
                return #requestHistory >= 1
            end)

            test("Logging of request function (global)", function()
                clearLogs()
                local req = request or http_request or genv.request or genv.http_request
                if not req then return false end
                req({ Url = "https://httpbin.org/get", Method = "GET" })
                task.wait(0.1)
                return #requestHistory >= 1
            end)

            -- Category 3: Blocking
            addResultLine("\n┌── [ CATEGORY: Blocking & Firewall ] ─────────────────────┐")
            local savedBlockWebhooks = blockWebhooks
            local savedBlockAll = blockAllTraffic
            local savedLogAll = logAllTraffic
            logAllTraffic = true

            test("Webhook blocking (enabled)", function()
                blockWebhooks = true
                local req = request or http_request or genv.request or genv.http_request
                if not req then return false end
                local resp = req({
                    Url = "https://discord.com/api/webhooks/123/abc",
                    Method = "POST",
                    Body = "test"
                })
                blockWebhooks = savedBlockWebhooks
                return resp and resp.StatusCode == 403
            end)

            test("All-traffic blocking (enabled)", function()
                blockAllTraffic = true
                local req = request or http_request or genv.request or genv.http_request
                if not req then return false end
                local resp = req({ Url = "https://httpbin.org/get", Method = "GET" })
                blockAllTraffic = savedBlockAll
                return resp and resp.StatusCode == 403
            end)

            blockWebhooks = savedBlockWebhooks
            blockAllTraffic = savedBlockAll
            logAllTraffic = savedLogAll

            -- Category 4: Kick
            addResultLine("\n┌── [ CATEGORY: Anti-Kick & Auto-Save ] ───────────────────┐")
            test("LocalPlayer:Kick is hooked and protected", function()
                return kickHooked == true
            end)

            test("Kick triggers clipboard save (simulated)", function()
                local ok = pcall(emergencyClipboardSave)
                return ok
            end)

            -- Category 5: WebSocket
            addResultLine("\n┌── [ CATEGORY: WebSocket Protection ] ────────────────────┐")
            local wsConnect = wsLib and wsLib.connect
            if wsConnect then
                test("WebSocket.connect is hooked", function()
                    return wsConnectedHooked == true
                end)

                test("WebSocket connection is logged (or blocked)", function()
                    clearLogs()
                    local ok, err = pcall(function()
                        local wsInst = wsConnect("wss://echo.websocket.events")
                        if wsInst and wsInst.Close then wsInst:Close() end
                    end)
                    task.wait(0.1)
                    return #requestHistory >= 1 or (err and string.find(tostring(err), "blocked"))
                end)
            else
                skip("WebSocket.connect is available", "No WebSocket library found")
            end

            -- Category 6: Environment
            addResultLine("\n┌── [ CATEGORY: Environment & Global Safety ] ─────────────┐")
            test("No extraneous global variables injected", function()
                local ourNames = {"OrionLib", "HttpService", "requestHistory", "webhookDomains", "isScanning", "logAllTraffic", "blockWebhooks", "blockAllTraffic"}
                local g = getgenv and getgenv() or _G
                for _, name in ipairs(ourNames) do
                    if g[name] ~= nil then
                        return false
                    end
                end
                return true
            end)

            -- Category 7: Performance
            addResultLine("\n┌── [ CATEGORY: Performance & Latency ] ───────────────────┐")
            test("Request latency within acceptable bounds (< 500ms)", function()
                local req = request or http_request or genv.request or genv.http_request
                if not req then return false end
                local start = tick()
                req({ Url = "https://httpbin.org/get", Method = "GET" })
                local elapsed = (tick() - start) * 1000
                return elapsed < 500
            end)

            -- Summary
            local totalTime = string.format("%.2f", tick() - startTime)
            local totalTests = passed + failed + skipped
            local rate = totalTests > 0 and math.floor((passed / (passed + failed)) * 100) or 0

            addResultLine("\n============================================================")
            addResultLine(string.format(" Protection Summary | Score: %d%% Pass Rate", rate))
            addResultLine(string.format("   • Passed:  %d", passed))
            addResultLine(string.format("   • Failed:  %d", failed))
            addResultLine(string.format("   • Skipped: %d", skipped))
            addResultLine(string.format("   • Execution Time: %ss", totalTime))
            addResultLine("============================================================\n")

            testResultsOutput = table.concat(testResultLines, "\n")

            OrionLib:MakeNotification({
                Name = "Test Suite Complete",
                Content = string.format("Passed: %d | Failed: %d | Skipped: %d (%d%% Pass Rate)", passed, failed, skipped, rate),
                Time = 5
            })
        end)
    end
})

SpyTab:AddButton({
    Name = "📋 Copy Test Results to Clipboard",
    Callback = function()
        if testResultsOutput == "" then
            OrionLib:MakeNotification({
                Name = "No Test Results",
                Content = "Please run test suite first.",
                Time = 3
            })
            return
        end

        local ok, err = pcall(setclipboard, testResultsOutput)
        if not ok then
            OrionLib:MakeNotification({
                Name = "Clipboard Error",
                Content = "Failed to copy: " .. tostring(err),
                Time = 4
            })
            return
        end
        OrionLib:MakeNotification({
            Name = "Test Results Copied!",
            Content = "Full test report is now in your clipboard.",
            Time = 4
        })
    end
})

OrionLib:Init()
