scripts.author: Gorrr
scripts.summary: This ai is good at everything! It dose all the puzzles, I detects threat levels for bears, it has the best moment possible, it survives and detects everything in its path, etc.
scripts.code:
--[[
	WARNING: Heads up! This script has not been verified by ScriptBlox. Use at your own risk!
]]
--[[
	BearAI.client.lua
	-----------------
	A fair-play "player brain" for YOUR OWN copy of a Bear-style survival game.

	WHERE IT GOES:  StarterPlayer > StarterPlayerScripts  (make it a LocalScript)

	TOGGLE: press CONFIG.ToggleKey (default P) or click the status box in the corner.
	TIP:    turn Workspace.StreamingEnabled OFF so the AI can see the whole map.

	DELTA COMPATIBILITY NOTES:
	  - ProximityPrompt interaction uses fireproximityprompt (Delta) as the primary method,
	    then falls back to InputHoldBegin/End, then to a manual wait.
	  - Pathfinding falls back to direct Humanoid:MoveTo if PathfindingService is blocked,
	    but still tries ring points around unreachable goals when the service works but reports NoPath.
	  - Character is fully loaded before the AI starts.
]]

if not game:IsLoaded() then
	game.Loaded:Wait()
end

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")
local PathfindingService = game:GetService("PathfindingService")
local CollectionService = game:GetService("CollectionService")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")

local player = Players.LocalPlayer

--==============================================================================
-- CONFIG
--==============================================================================
local CONFIG = {
	StartEnabled = true,
	ToggleKey = Enum.KeyCode.P,
	ShowHud = true,
	ShowPath = true,
	IsActive = nil,
	SetSprint = nil,

	BearNames = { "Bear" },
	BearTag = "Bear",
	BearTeamNames = { "Bear" },
	IsBear = nil,

	PuzzleNames = {},
	PuzzleTag = "Puzzle",
	HideSpotTag = "HideSpot",
	ExitTag = "Exit",

	PriorityWords = { "key", "fuse", "battery", "gear", "pick", "take", "grab", "collect", "code", "lever", "button", "switch", "generator", "power", "fix", "repair", "unlock", "insert", "place" },
	ExitWords = { "exit", "escape", "finish", "leave" },
	HideWords = { "hide", "hiding", "locker", "closet", "wardrobe" },
	IgnoreWords = { "shop", "buy", "purchase", "robux", "gamepass", "skin", "vip", "settings", "spectate", "redeem" },

	SightDistance = 90,
	HearDistance = 38,
	MemorySeconds = 7,

	AssumedBearSpeed = 18,
	PanicDistance = 16,
	DangerSeconds = 2.6,
	DangerHoldSeconds = 1.2,
	ObjectiveClearance = 30,
	SafetyMarginSeconds = 1.5,
	FleeCommitSeconds = 0.9,
	HideMaxApproach = 40,
	HideMaxSeconds = 18,
	HideClearSeconds = 3.5,

	RetryCooldown = 5,
	MaxAttempts = 4,

	CustomSolvers = {},
	IsSolved = nil,
}

--==============================================================================
-- STATE
--==============================================================================
local character, humanoid, root
local enabled = CONFIG.StartEnabled
local plan, planToken = nil, 0

local memory = { done = {}, attempts = {}, cool = {} }
local threat = { level = "safe", dist = math.huge, ttc = math.huge, los = false }
local lastSeenPos, lastSeenTime, lastSeenBear, lastDangerTime = nil, 0, nil, -100
local tracks, warned = {}, {}
local sprinting = false

local prompts, tools, bears, namedPuzzles, teamBears = {}, {}, {}, {}, {}
local classCache = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })

local AGENT = { AgentRadius = 2, AgentHeight = 5, AgentCanJump = true, WaypointSpacing = 4 }

local function alive()
	return humanoid ~= nil and root ~= nil and humanoid.Health > 0 and root.Parent ~= nil
end

local function isCurrent(token)
	return enabled and token == planToken and alive()
end

local function warnOnce(key, message)
	if warned[key] then return end
	warned[key] = true
	warn("[BearAI] " .. message)
end

local function setSprint(on)
	if sprinting == on then return end
	sprinting = on
	if CONFIG.SetSprint then
		pcall(CONFIG.SetSprint, on)
	end
end

--==============================================================================
-- HELPERS
--==============================================================================
local function lower(s) return string.lower(tostring(s or "")) end

local function hasWord(text, list)
	text = lower(text)
	for _, word in ipairs(list) do
		if string.find(text, lower(word), 1, true) then return true end
	end
	return false
end

local function flat(v) return Vector3.new(v.X, 0, v.Z) end

local function positionOf(inst)
	if not inst then return nil end
	if inst:IsA("BasePart") then return inst.Position end
	if inst:IsA("Attachment") then return inst.WorldPosition end
	if inst:IsA("Model") then return inst:GetPivot().Position end
	if inst:IsA("ProximityPrompt") then return positionOf(inst.Parent) end
	return nil
end

local function taggedUp(inst, tag)
	local cur = inst
	while cur and cur ~= Workspace do
		if CollectionService:HasTag(cur, tag) then return true end
		cur = cur.Parent
	end
	return false
end

local function textOf(prompt)
	local parts = { prompt.ActionText, prompt.ObjectText }
	local cur = prompt.Parent
	for _ = 1, 4 do
		if not cur or cur == Workspace then break end
		table.insert(parts, cur.Name)
		cur = cur.Parent
	end
	return table.concat(parts, " ")
end

local function insideCharacter(inst)
	local cur = inst.Parent
	while cur and cur ~= Workspace do
		if cur:IsA("Model") and cur:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") then
			return true
		end
		cur = cur.Parent
	end
	return false
end

local rayParams = RaycastParams.new()
rayParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
rayParams.RespectCanCollide = true
rayParams.IgnoreWater = true

local function ignoreList()
	local list = { character }
	if lastSeenBear and lastSeenBear.Parent then
		table.insert(list, lastSeenBear)
	end
	return list
end

local function castRay(from, to, ignore)
	rayParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = ignore or ignoreList()
	return Workspace:Raycast(from, to - from, rayParams)
end

local function clearLine(from, to, ignore)
	return castRay(from, to, ignore) == nil
end

--==============================================================================
-- WORLD REGISTRY
--==============================================================================
local function isBearModel(model)
	if model == character then return false end
	if CollectionService:HasTag(model, CONFIG.BearTag) then return true end
	if CONFIG.IsBear then
		local ok, res = pcall(CONFIG.IsBear, model)
		if ok and res then return true end
	end
	if Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(model) then return false end
	local lname = lower(model.Name)
	for _, name in ipairs(CONFIG.BearNames) do
		if lname == lower(name) then return true end
	end
	return string.find(lname, "bear", 1, true) ~= nil and model:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") ~= nil
end

local hasNamedPuzzles = #CONFIG.PuzzleNames > 0
local puzzleNameSet = {}
for _, name in ipairs(CONFIG.PuzzleNames) do
	puzzleNameSet[lower(name)] = true
end

local function register(inst)
	if inst:IsA("ProximityPrompt") then
		prompts[inst] = true
	elseif inst:IsA("Tool") then
		tools[inst] = true
	elseif inst:IsA("Model") then
		if hasNamedPuzzles and puzzleNameSet[lower(inst.Name)] then
			namedPuzzles[inst] = true
		end
		task.defer(function()
			if inst.Parent and isBearModel(inst) then
				bears[inst] = true
			end
		end)
	elseif hasNamedPuzzles and inst:IsA("BasePart") and puzzleNameSet[lower(inst.Name)] then
		namedPuzzles[inst] = true
	end
end

local function unregister(inst)
	prompts[inst] = nil
	tools[inst] = nil
	bears[inst] = nil
	namedPuzzles[inst] = nil
end

local function refreshPlayerBears()
	for model in pairs(teamBears) do
		bears[model] = nil
	end
	teamBears = {}
	for _, other in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		local char = other.Character
		if other ~= player and char then
			local isBear = isBearModel(char)
			if not isBear and other.Team then
				local teamName = lower(other.Team.Name)
				for _, name in ipairs(CONFIG.BearTeamNames) do
					if teamName == lower(name) then isBear = true end
				end
			end
			if isBear then
				bears[char] = true
				teamBears[char] = true
			end
		end
	end
end

local function resetMemory()
	memory.done, memory.attempts, memory.cool = {}, {}, {}
	tracks, warned = {}, {}
	lastSeenPos, lastSeenTime, lastSeenBear, lastDangerTime = nil, 0, nil, -100
	threat = { level = "safe", dist = math.huge, ttc = math.huge, los = false }
end

--==============================================================================
-- PERCEPTION
--==============================================================================
local function bearRootOf(bear)
	return bear:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or bear.PrimaryPart or bear:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)
end

local function knownBearPos()
	if threat.pos then return threat.pos end
	if lastSeenPos and os.clock() - lastSeenTime <= CONFIG.MemorySeconds then
		return lastSeenPos
	end
	return nil
end

local function perceive()
	local now = os.clock()
	local myPos = root.Position
	local best = { level = "safe", dist = math.huge, ttc = math.huge, los = false }

	for bear in pairs(bears) do
		local br = bear.Parent and bearRootOf(bear)
		if br then
			local bpos = br.Position
			local vel = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
			local track = tracks[bear]
			if track then
				local dt = now - track.t
				if dt >= 0.05 then
					vel = track.vel:Lerp((bpos - track.pos) / dt, 0.5)
					track.pos, track.t, track.vel = bpos, now, vel
				else
					vel = track.vel
				end
			else
				tracks[bear] = { pos = bpos, t = now, vel = vel }
			end

			local flatVel = flat(vel)
			local toMe = myPos - bpos
			local dist = toMe.Magnitude
			local closing = dist > 0.1 and flatVel:Dot(toMe / dist) or 0
			local ttc = dist / math.max(flatVel.Magnitude, CONFIG.AssumedBearSpeed)
			local sees = dist <= CONFIG.SightDistance
				and clearLine(bpos + Vector3.new(0, 2, 0), myPos + Vector3.new(0, 1.5, 0), { character, bear })
			local heard = dist <= CONFIG.HearDistance

			if sees or heard then
				lastSeenPos, lastSeenTime, lastSeenBear = bpos, now, bear
				local level = "alert"
				if dist <= CONFIG.PanicDistance
					or (sees and ttc <= CONFIG.DangerSeconds)
					or ((not sees) and closing > 4 and ttc <= CONFIG.DangerSeconds * 0.6) then
					level = "danger"
				end
				local better = best.level == "safe"
					or (level == "danger" and best.level == "alert")
					or (level == best.level and ttc < best.ttc)
				if better then
					best = { level = level, dist = dist, ttc = ttc, los = sees, pos = bpos, bear = bear }
				end
			end
		end
	end

	if best.level == "danger" then
		lastDangerTime = now
	elseif best.level == "alert" and now - lastDangerTime < CONFIG.DangerHoldSeconds then
		best.level = "danger"
	end
	threat = best
end

local function safeToPursue(pos)
	local b = knownBearPos()
	if not b then return true end
	local bearDist = (pos - b).Magnitude
	if bearDist < CONFIG.ObjectiveClearance then return false end
	local myDist = (pos - root.Position).Magnitude
	local tBear = bearDist / CONFIG.AssumedBearSpeed
	local tMe = myDist / math.max(humanoid.WalkSpeed, 1)
	return tBear > tMe + CONFIG.SafetyMarginSeconds
end

--==============================================================================
-- ESCAPE TACTICS
--==============================================================================
local function openness(point)
	local free = 0
	for i = 0, 7 do
		local a = i * math.pi / 4
		local from = point + Vector3.new(0, 2, 0)
		local to = from + Vector3.new(math.cos(a) * 12, 0, math.sin(a) * 12)
		if not castRay(from, to) then free = free + 1 end
	end
	return free
end

local function pickFleePoint(sneak)
	local origin = root.Position
	local backwards = -flat(root.CFrame.LookVector)
	local bpos = knownBearPos() or (origin + backwards * -20)
	local toBear = flat(bpos - origin)
	local toBearDir = toBear.Magnitude > 0.1 and toBear.Unit or backwards
	local mySpeed = math.max(humanoid.WalkSpeed, 1)
	local bearSpeed = CONFIG.AssumedBearSpeed
	local radii = sneak and { 8, 14, 20 } or { 16, 26, 38 }
	local eye = Vector3.new(0, 2, 0)
	local best, bestScore

	for i = 0, 15 do
		local a = i / 16 * math.pi * 2
		local dir = Vector3.new(math.cos(a), 0, math.sin(a))
		local toward = math.max(0, dir:Dot(toBearDir))
		for _, r in ipairs(radii) do
			local probe = origin + dir * r
			local hit = castRay(probe + Vector3.new(0, 25, 0), probe + Vector3.new(0, -35, 0))
			if hit and math.abs(hit.Position.Y - origin.Y) < 14 then
				local cand = hit.Position
				local wallBetween = castRay(origin + eye, cand + eye) ~= nil
				local margin = math.clamp((cand - bpos).Magnitude / bearSpeed - (cand - origin).Magnitude / mySpeed, -4, 6)
				local hidden = not clearLine(bpos + eye, cand + eye)
				local score = margin * 10
					+ (hidden and 25 or 0)
					+ (wallBetween and -25 or 15)
					+ openness(cand) * 4
					- toward * 30
				if not best or score > bestScore then
					best, bestScore = cand, score
				end
			end
		end
	end
	return best
end

local function fleeStillGood(p)
	local b = knownBearPos()
	if not b or not p.dest then return true end
	local myD = (p.dest - root.Position).Magnitude
	if myD < 6 then return false end
	local bearT = (p.dest - b).Magnitude / CONFIG.AssumedBearSpeed
	local meT = myD / math.max(humanoid.WalkSpeed, 1)
	return bearT - meT > 0.8
end

--==============================================================================
-- MOVEMENT
--==============================================================================
local pathFolder, pathOwner = nil, nil

local function clearPath(token)
	if pathFolder and (token == nil or pathOwner == token) then
		pathFolder:ClearAllChildren()
	end
end

local function drawPath(waypoints, token)
	if not CONFIG.ShowPath then return end
	if not pathFolder then
		pathFolder = Instance.new("Folder")
		pathFolder.Name = "BearAI_Path"
		pathFolder.Parent = Workspace
	end
	pathOwner = token
	pathFolder:ClearAllChildren()
	for _, wp in ipairs(waypoints) do
		local dot = Instance.new("Part")
		dot.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
		dot.Size = Vector3.new(0.7, 0.7, 0.7)
		dot.Position = wp.Position + Vector3.new(0, 0.5, 0)
		dot.Anchored = true
		dot.CanCollide = false
		dot.CanQuery = false
		dot.CanTouch = false
		dot.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
		dot.Color = wp.Action == Enum.PathWaypointAction.Jump and Color3.fromRGB(255, 200, 0) or Color3.fromRGB(0, 200, 255)
		dot.Parent = pathFolder
	end
end

local function ringPoints(center, radius)
	local points = {}
	for i = 0, 7 do
		local a = i * math.pi / 4
		local probe = center + Vector3.new(math.cos(a) * radius, 0, math.sin(a) * radius)
		local hit = castRay(probe + Vector3.new(0, 8, 0), probe + Vector3.new(0, -24, 0))
		if hit then table.insert(points, hit.Position) end
	end
	local me = root.Position
	table.sort(points, function(p, q)
		return (p - me).Magnitude < (q - me).Magnitude
	end)
	return points
end

local function followOnce(goal, target, token, opts)
	local path = PathfindingService:CreatePath(AGENT)
	local ok = pcall(function()
		path:ComputeAsync(root.Position, goal)
	end)
	if not isCurrent(token) then return "cancelled" end

	-- FIX: distinguish "service broken" (direct fallback) from "no path to goal" (try ring points)
	if not ok then
		return "direct"
	end
	if path.Status ~= Enum.PathStatus.Success then
		return "nopath"
	end

	local waypoints = path:GetWaypoints()
	drawPath(waypoints, token)
	local blockedAt = nil
	local blockedConn = path.Blocked:Connect(function(index) blockedAt = index end)

	local result = "arrived"
	for i = 2, #waypoints do
		local wp = waypoints[i]
		if wp.Action == Enum.PathWaypointAction.Jump then
			humanoid.Jump = true
		end
		humanoid:MoveTo(wp.Position)

		local lastDist, lastProgress, jumped = math.huge, os.clock(), false
		local closeEnough = false
		while true do
			if not isCurrent(token) then result = "cancelled"; break end
			local pos = root.Position
			if opts.stopWithin and (pos - target).Magnitude <= opts.stopWithin then
				closeEnough = true; break
			end
			if blockedAt and blockedAt >= i then result = "replan"; break end
			local d = (flat(pos) - flat(wp.Position)).Magnitude
			if d <= 2.5 then break end
			local now = os.clock()
			if d < lastDist - 0.4 then lastDist, lastProgress = d, now end
			if now - lastProgress > 1.4 then
				if jumped then result = "stuck"; break end
				jumped = true
				lastProgress = now
				humanoid.Jump = true
				humanoid:MoveTo(wp.Position)
			end
			task.wait(0.05)
		end
		if closeEnough or result ~= "arrived" then break end
	end

	blockedConn:Disconnect()
	clearPath(token)
	return result
end

local function goTo(target, token, opts)
	opts = opts or {}
	local deadline = os.clock() + (opts.maxTime or 25)
	local goals, gi, tries = { target }, 1, 0

	while isCurrent(token) and os.clock() < deadline and tries < 14 do
		tries = tries + 1
		if opts.stopWithin and (root.Position - target).Magnitude <= opts.stopWithin then
			return "arrived"
		end
		local r = followOnce(goals[gi], target, token, opts)
		if r == "arrived" or r == "cancelled" then return r end
		if r == "direct" then
			humanoid:MoveTo(goals[gi])
			local start = os.clock()
			while isCurrent(token) and os.clock() - start < (opts.maxTime or 25) do
				if opts.stopWithin and (root.Position - target).Magnitude <= opts.stopWithin then
					return "arrived"
				end
				if (flat(root.Position) - flat(goals[gi])).Magnitude <= 2.5 then
					return "arrived"
				end
				task.wait(0.1)
			end
			if not isCurrent(token) then return "cancelled" end
			return "failed"
		end
		if r == "nopath" then
			if #goals == 1 then
				for _, p in ipairs(ringPoints(target, 4)) do
					table.insert(goals, p)
				end
			end
			gi = gi + 1
			if gi > #goals then return "nopath" end
		end
		task.wait(0.05)
	end
	if not isCurrent(token) then return "cancelled" end
	return "failed"
end

--==============================================================================
-- INTERACTION
--==============================================================================
local function inventoryCount()
	local n = 0
	local backpack = player:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack")
	if backpack then
		for _, item in ipairs(backpack:GetChildren()) do
			if item:IsA("Tool") then n = n + 1 end
		end
	end
	for _, item in ipairs(character:GetChildren()) do
		if item:IsA("Tool") then n = n + 1 end
	end
	return n
end

local function uiSignature()
	local gui = player:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui")
	if not gui then return "" end
	local names = {}
	for _, g in ipairs(gui:GetChildren()) do
		if g:IsA("ScreenGui") and g.Enabled and g.Name ~= "BearAI_HUD" then
			local visible = 0
			for _, child in ipairs(g:GetChildren()) do
				if child:IsA("GuiObject") and child.Visible then
					visible = visible + 1
				end
			end
			table.insert(names, g.Name .. ":" .. visible)
		end
	end
	table.sort(names)
	return table.concat(names, ",")
end

local function snapshot(prompt)
	return {
		enabled = prompt.Enabled,
		action = prompt.ActionText,
		object = prompt.ObjectText,
		items = inventoryCount(),
	}
end

local function promptChanged(prompt, before)
	if not prompt:IsDescendantOf(Workspace) then return true end
	return prompt.Enabled ~= before.enabled
		or prompt.ActionText ~= before.action
		or prompt.ObjectText ~= before.object
		or inventoryCount() ~= before.items
end

-- Delta-compatible prompt interaction
local function holdPrompt(prompt, token)
	if not isCurrent(token) then return false end

	-- 1. fireproximityprompt (Delta)
	if fireproximityprompt then
		local ok = pcall(fireproximityprompt, prompt)
		if ok then
			task.wait(0.1)
			return isCurrent(token)
		end
	end

	-- 2. Native InputHoldBegin/End
	local ok = pcall(function() prompt:InputHoldBegin() end)
	if ok then
		local started, needed = os.clock(), prompt.HoldDuration + 0.2
		while os.clock() - started < needed and isCurrent(token) do
			task.wait(0.05)
		end
		pcall(function() prompt:InputHoldEnd() end)
		return isCurrent(token)
	end

	-- 3. Manual wait (some executors block InputHoldBegin)
	if isCurrent(token) then
		task.wait(prompt.HoldDuration + 0.2)
		pcall(function() prompt:InputHoldEnd() end)
		return isCurrent(token)
	end
	return false
end

local function equipMatchingTool(prompt, attempts)
	local list = {}
	local backpack = player:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack")
	if backpack then
		for _, item in ipairs(backpack:GetChildren()) do
			if item:IsA("Tool") then table.insert(list, item) end
		end
	end
	for _, item in ipairs(character:GetChildren()) do
		if item:IsA("Tool") then table.insert(list, item) end
	end
	if #list == 0 then return end
	local text = lower(textOf(prompt))
	for _, tool in ipairs(list) do
		if #tool.Name > 0 and string.find(text, lower(tool.Name), 1, true) then
			humanoid:EquipTool(tool)
			return
		end
	end
	if attempts >= 2 then
		humanoid:EquipTool(list[(attempts - 2) % #list + 1])
	end
end

local function usePrompt(obj, token, attempts)
	local prompt = obj.prompt
	local pos = positionOf(prompt.Parent) or obj.pos
	local within = math.max(math.clamp(prompt.MaxActivationDistance * 0.55, 2.5, 7) / attempts, 2)

	local res = goTo(pos, token, { stopWithin = within, maxTime = 30 })
	if res ~= "arrived" then return res end

	equipMatchingTool(prompt, attempts)
	local before, uiBefore = snapshot(prompt), uiSignature()
	if not holdPrompt(prompt, token) then return "cancelled" end

	local started = os.clock()
	while isCurrent(token) and os.clock() - started < 1.2 do
		if promptChanged(prompt, before) then return "done" end
		task.wait(0.1)
	end
	if not isCurrent(token) then return "cancelled" end
	if uiSignature() ~= uiBefore then return "ui" end
	return "nochange"
end

--==============================================================================
-- OBJECTIVES
--==============================================================================
local function classify(prompt)
	local c = classCache[prompt]
	if c then return c.kind, c.bonus end
	local text = textOf(prompt)
	local kind = "task"
	if insideCharacter(prompt) or hasWord(text, CONFIG.IgnoreWords) then
		kind = "ignore"
	elseif taggedUp(prompt, CONFIG.HideSpotTag) or hasWord(text, CONFIG.HideWords) then
		kind = "hide"
	elseif hasWord(text, CONFIG.ExitWords) then
		kind = "exit"
	end
	local bonus = hasWord(text, CONFIG.PriorityWords) and 1 or 0
	classCache[prompt] = { kind = kind, bonus = bonus }
	return kind, bonus
end

local function isLooseTool(tool)
	return tool:IsDescendantOf(Workspace) and not insideCharacter(tool)
end

local function isSolved(inst)
	if inst:GetAttribute("Solved") == true or inst:GetAttribute("Completed") == true or inst:GetAttribute("Done") == true then
		return true
	end
	if CONFIG.IsSolved then
		local ok, res = pcall(CONFIG.IsSolved, inst)
		return ok and res == true
	end
	return false
end

local function chooseObjective()
	local now = os.clock()
	local me = root.Position
	local tasks, exits = {}, {}
	local explicit, scoped = {}, false

	for _, inst in ipairs(CollectionService:GetTagged(CONFIG.PuzzleTag)) do
		if inst:IsDescendantOf(Workspace) then explicit[inst] = true end
	end
	for inst in pairs(namedPuzzles) do
		if inst:IsDescendantOf(Workspace) then explicit[inst] = true end
	end

	local function add(list, obj)
		if memory.done[obj.key] or (memory.attempts[obj.key] or 0) >= CONFIG.MaxAttempts then return end
		table.insert(list, obj)
	end

	for inst in pairs(explicit) do
		scoped = true
		local pos = positionOf(inst)
		if pos and not isSolved(inst) then
			add(tasks, {
				key = inst, inst = inst,
				prompt = inst:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("ProximityPrompt", true),
				pos = pos, bonus = 1,
			})
		end
	end

	-- FIX: check IsDescendantOf before .Enabled (safer for destroyed prompts)
	for prompt in pairs(prompts) do
		if prompt:IsDescendantOf(Workspace) and prompt.Enabled then
			local kind, bonus = classify(prompt)
			local pos = positionOf(prompt.Parent)
			if pos then
				if kind == "task" and not scoped then
					add(tasks, { key = prompt, inst = prompt.Parent, prompt = prompt, pos = pos, bonus = bonus })
				elseif kind == "exit" then
					add(exits, { key = prompt, inst = prompt.Parent, prompt = prompt, pos = pos, bonus = 0, exit = true })
				end
			end
		end
	end

	for tool in pairs(tools) do
		if isLooseTool(tool) then
			local handle = tool:FindFirstChild("Handle")
			if handle then
				add(tasks, { key = tool, inst = tool, pos = handle.Position, bonus = 2, pickup = true })
			end
		end
	end

	for _, part in ipairs(CollectionService:GetTagged(CONFIG.ExitTag)) do
		local pos = part:IsDescendantOf(Workspace) and positionOf(part)
		if pos then
			add(exits, { key = part, inst = part, pos = pos, bonus = 0, exit = true, touch = true })
		end
	end

	local function pick(list)
		local best, bestScore
		for _, obj in ipairs(list) do
			if (memory.cool[obj.key] or 0) <= now and safeToPursue(obj.pos) then
				local score = obj.bonus * 25 - (obj.pos - me).Magnitude
				if plan and plan.obj and plan.obj.key == obj.key and not plan.finished then
					score = score + 30
				end
				if not bestScore or score > bestScore then
					best, bestScore = obj, score
				end
			end
		end
		return best
	end

	local best = pick(tasks)
	if best then return best end
	if #tasks > 0 then return nil end
	return pick(exits)
end

local function bestHideSpot()
	local now = os.clock()
	local b = knownBearPos()
	local me = root.Position
	local best, bestDist
	for prompt in pairs(prompts) do
		-- FIX: check IsDescendantOf first
		if prompt:IsDescendantOf(Workspace) and prompt.Enabled
			and (memory.cool[prompt] or 0) <= now
			and classify(prompt) == "hide" then
			local pos = positionOf(prompt.Parent)
			if pos then
				local myDist = (pos - me).Magnitude
				if myDist <= CONFIG.HideMaxApproach and (not b or (pos - b).Magnitude > myDist * 1.3 + 8) then
					if not bestDist or myDist < bestDist then
						best, bestDist = prompt, myDist
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end
	return best
end

--==============================================================================
-- BEHAVIOURS
--==============================================================================
local function findSolver(obj)
	local cur = obj.inst
	while cur and cur ~= Workspace do
		local solver = CONFIG.CustomSolvers[cur.Name]
		if solver then return solver end
		cur = cur.Parent
	end
	return nil
end

local function makeContext(obj, token)
	local ctx = {
		player = player,
		character = character,
		humanoid = humanoid,
		root = root,
		instance = obj.inst,
		prompt = obj.prompt,
		position = obj.pos,
	}
	function ctx.alive() return isCurrent(token) end
	function ctx.walkTo(pos, within)
		return goTo(pos, token, { stopWithin = within or 4, maxTime = 30 })
	end
	function ctx.pressPrompt(p)
		p = p or obj.prompt
		if not p then return false end
		return holdPrompt(p, token)
	end
	return ctx
end

local function runPickup(obj, token, attempts)
	local tool = obj.inst
	local handle = tool:FindFirstChild("Handle")
	if not handle then
		memory.attempts[tool] = CONFIG.MaxAttempts
		return
	end
	local before = inventoryCount()
	local res = goTo(handle.Position, token, { stopWithin = 2.5, maxTime = 25 })
	if res == "cancelled" then return end
	if res == "arrived" then
		humanoid:MoveTo(handle.Position)
		local started = os.clock()
		while isCurrent(token) and os.clock() - started < 1.5 do
			if inventoryCount() ~= before or not tool:IsDescendantOf(Workspace) then
				memory.done[tool] = true
				return
			end
			task.wait(0.1)
		end
	end
	if isCurrent(token) then
		memory.attempts[tool] = attempts
		memory.cool[tool] = os.clock() + CONFIG.RetryCooldown * attempts
	end
end

local function runObjective(p, token)
	local obj = p.obj
	local attempts = (memory.attempts[obj.key] or 0) + 1

	if obj.touch then
		goTo(obj.pos, token, { stopWithin = 3, maxTime = 30 })
		if isCurrent(token) then task.wait(1) end
		return
	end

	if obj.pickup then
		runPickup(obj, token, attempts)
		return
	end

	local solver = findSolver(obj)
	if solver then
		local ok, result = pcall(solver, makeContext(obj, token))
		if not isCurrent(token) then return end
		if ok and result then
			memory.done[obj.key] = true
		else
			if not ok then
				warn("[BearAI] solver for '" .. obj.inst.Name .. "' errored: " .. tostring(result))
			end
			memory.attempts[obj.key] = attempts
			memory.cool[obj.key] = os.clock() + CONFIG.RetryCooldown * attempts
		end
		return
	end

	if not obj.prompt then
		warnOnce(obj.key, "'" .. obj.inst.Name .. "' has no ProximityPrompt and no CustomSolver yet, so the AI can't finish it.")
		memory.attempts[obj.key] = CONFIG.MaxAttempts
		return
	end

	local result = usePrompt(obj, token, attempts)
	if result == "done" then
		memory.done[obj.key] = true
	elseif result == "ui" then
		warnOnce(obj.key, "'" .. obj.inst.Name .. "' opened a UI (probably a minigame puzzle). Add a CustomSolver named '" .. obj.inst.Name .. "' to finish it.")
		memory.attempts[obj.key] = CONFIG.MaxAttempts
	elseif result ~= "cancelled" then
		memory.attempts[obj.key] = attempts
		memory.cool[obj.key] = os.clock() + CONFIG.RetryCooldown * attempts
	end
end

local function runHide(p, token)
	local prompt = p.target
	local pos = positionOf(prompt.Parent)
	if not pos or goTo(pos, token, { stopWithin = 4, maxTime = 8 }) ~= "arrived" then
		memory.cool[prompt] = os.clock() + 6
		return
	end
	holdPrompt(prompt, token)

	local started, calmSince = os.clock(), nil
	while isCurrent(token) and os.clock() - started < CONFIG.HideMaxSeconds do
		if threat.level == "safe" then
			calmSince = calmSince or os.clock()
			if os.clock() - calmSince >= CONFIG.HideClearSeconds then break end
		else
			calmSince = nil
		end
		task.wait(0.2)
	end

	if isCurrent(token) and prompt.Enabled then
		holdPrompt(prompt, token)
	end
	memory.cool[prompt] = os.clock() + 4
end

local function runPlan(p, token)
	if p.kind == "Flee" then
		setSprint(p.mode == "run")
		goTo(p.dest, token, { maxTime = 3.5 })
	elseif p.kind == "Hide" then
		setSprint(true)
		runHide(p, token)
		setSprint(false)
	elseif p.kind == "Objective" then
		setSprint(false)
		runObjective(p, token)
	end
end

--==============================================================================
-- THE BRAIN
--==============================================================================
local function decide()
	local now = os.clock()

	if plan and not plan.finished and (plan.kind == "Hide" or plan.kind == "Flee") and now < (plan.commitUntil or 0) then
		return plan
	end

	if threat.level == "danger" then
		if plan and not plan.finished and plan.kind == "Flee" and plan.mode == "run" and fleeStillGood(plan) then
			return plan
		end
		local spot = bestHideSpot()
		if spot then
			return { kind = "Hide", target = spot, commitUntil = now + CONFIG.HideMaxSeconds + 4 }
		end
		local dest = pickFleePoint(false)
		if dest then
			return { kind = "Flee", mode = "run", dest = dest, commitUntil = now + CONFIG.FleeCommitSeconds }
		end
		return nil
	end

	local obj = chooseObjective()
	if obj then
		return { kind = "Objective", target = obj.key, obj = obj }
	end

	if threat.level == "alert" and threat.los then
		if plan and not plan.finished and plan.kind == "Flee" and plan.mode == "sneak" and fleeStillGood(plan) then
			return plan
		end
		local dest = pickFleePoint(true)
		if dest then
			return { kind = "Flee", mode = "sneak", dest = dest, commitUntil = now + 0.6 }
		end
	end

	return nil
end

local function setPlan(newPlan)
	planToken = planToken + 1
	local token = planToken
	if plan then plan.finished = true end
	plan = newPlan

	if not newPlan then
		setSprint(false)
		if alive() then humanoid:MoveTo(root.Position) end
		return
	end

	task.spawn(function()
		local ok, err = pcall(runPlan, newPlan, token)
		if not ok then warn("[BearAI] " .. tostring(err)) end
		if planToken == token then
			newPlan.finished = true
			plan = nil
		end
	end)
end

local function think()
	perceive()
	local want = decide()
	if want == plan then return end
	if want == nil and plan == nil then
		setSprint(false)
		return
	end
	if want and plan and not plan.finished and want.kind == plan.kind and want.target ~= nil and want.target == plan.target then
		return
	end
	setPlan(want)
end

local function setEnabled(on)
	enabled = on
	planToken = planToken + 1
	if plan then plan.finished = true end
	plan = nil
	setSprint(false)
	clearPath(nil)
	if alive() then humanoid:MoveTo(root.Position) end
end

local function activeNow()
	if not enabled or not alive() then return false end
	if CONFIG.IsActive then
		local ok, res = pcall(CONFIG.IsActive)
		return ok and res == true
	end
	return true
end

--==============================================================================
-- STATUS BOX
--==============================================================================
local hud

local function buildHud()
	if not CONFIG.ShowHud then return end
	local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
	gui.Name = "BearAI_HUD"
	gui.ResetOnSpawn = false

	hud = Instance.new("TextButton")
	hud.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(300, 84)
	hud.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(12, 60)
	hud.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(18, 18, 24)
	hud.BackgroundTransparency = 0.25
	hud.AutoButtonColor = false
	hud.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
	hud.Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium
	hud.TextSize = 14
	hud.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	hud.TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Top
	hud.TextWrapped = true
	hud.Text = ""

	local pad = Instance.new("UIPadding")
	pad.PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 10)
	pad.PaddingTop = UDim.new(0, 8)
	pad.Parent = hud

	local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
	corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
	corner.Parent = hud

	hud.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() setEnabled(not enabled) end)

	hud.Parent = gui
	gui.Parent = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
end

local function updateHud()
	if not hud then return end
	if not enabled then
		hud.Text = "Bear AI: OFF\n(" .. CONFIG.ToggleKey.Name .. " or click to turn on)"
		return
	end
	local doneCount = 0
	for _ in pairs(memory.done) do doneCount = doneCount + 1 end
	local doing = "idle"
	if plan then
		doing = plan.kind
		if plan.obj then
			doing = doing .. ": " .. plan.obj.inst.Name
		elseif plan.mode then
			doing = doing .. " (" .. plan.mode .. ")"
		end
	end
	local bearText = threat.level
	if threat.dist < math.huge then
		bearText = bearText .. string.format(" (%.0f studs)", threat.dist)
	end
	hud.Text = string.format("Bear AI: ON  (%s toggles)\nDoing: %s\nBear: %s\nTasks done: %d", CONFIG.ToggleKey.Name, doing, bearText, doneCount)
end

--==============================================================================
-- START UP
--==============================================================================
local function bindCharacter(char)
	-- FIX: guard against double-binding the same character
	if char == character then return end
	local hum = char:WaitForChild("Humanoid")
	local hrp = char:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	character, humanoid, root = char, hum, hrp
	resetMemory()
	planToken = planToken + 1
	plan = nil
	setSprint(false)
	hum.Died:Connect(function()
		planToken = planToken + 1
		plan = nil
		setSprint(false)
	end)
end

-- Ensure character is fully loaded before the AI starts
task.spawn(function()
	while not player.Character do
		task.wait(0.5)
	end
	bindCharacter(player.Character)
end)

player.CharacterAdded:Connect(bindCharacter)

buildHud()

for _, inst in ipairs(Workspace:GetDescendants()) do
	register(inst)
end
Workspace.DescendantAdded:Connect(register)
Workspace.DescendantRemoving:Connect(unregister)

for _, inst in ipairs(CollectionService:GetTagged(CONFIG.BearTag)) do
	if inst:IsA("Model") then bears[inst] = true end
end
CollectionService:GetInstanceAddedSignal(CONFIG.BearTag):Connect(function(inst)
	if inst:IsA("Model") then bears[inst] = true end
end)

task.spawn(function()
	while true do
		refreshPlayerBears()
		task.wait(1)
	end
end)

UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, processed)
	if not processed and input.KeyCode == CONFIG.ToggleKey then
		setEnabled(not enabled)
	end
end)

task.spawn(function()
	while true do
		task.wait(0.15)
		if activeNow() then
			local ok, err = pcall(think)
			if not ok then warn("[BearAI] " .. tostring(err)) end
		elseif plan then
			setPlan(nil)
		end
		updateHud()
	end
end)

scripts.title: mahoraga hub
scripts.author: daviluccasantosborg
scripts.summary: um hub que spawna o o mahoraga
scripts.code:
--[[
    Mahoraga Hub  (feito para Xeno)

    - GUI arrastável e fechável
    - Spawn: invoca UM Mahoraga (Jujutsu Kaisen) por vez, montado com Parts
      (roda de Dharma girando sobre a cabeça e a Espada da Extermínio no braço direito)
    - Ataque ON : ele te persegue e, se você chegar perto, te mata com a lâmina
    - Ataque OFF: ele só vagueia, sem te machucar
    - Ativo OFF : desativa ele por completo (congela, sem andar e sem atacar)
    - Em cima da cabeça você fica seguro e é levado por ele enquanto ele anda
    - Tudo roda só no seu cliente (só você vê o Mahoraga)
]]

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")

local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer

--------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Configurações
--------------------------------------------------------------------
local SPEED_WANDER = 9      -- velocidade passeando
local SPEED_CHASE = 20      -- velocidade perseguindo
local AGGRO_RANGE = 150     -- distância máxima para ele te notar
local ATTACK_START = 17     -- distância para começar a atacar
local REACH = 15            -- alcance da lâmina no momento do golpe
local GRACE_SECONDS = 4     -- tempo sem atacar logo após o spawn
local SWING_COOLDOWN = 1.6

--------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Onde colocar a GUI
--------------------------------------------------------------------
local okParent, guiParent = pcall(function()
    if gethui then return gethui() end
    return game:GetService("CoreGui")
end)
if not okParent or not guiParent then
    guiParent = LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
end

local old = guiParent:FindFirstChild("MahoragaHub")
if old then old:Destroy() end

--------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Estado
--------------------------------------------------------------------
local mah = nil            -- Mahoraga atual (só pode existir um)
local isActive = true      -- desativar/ativar
local isAggressive = true  -- pode te atacar ou não
local connections = {}

local BG = Color3.fromRGB(24, 22, 32)
local BAR = Color3.fromRGB(150, 105, 35)
local BTN = Color3.fromRGB(60, 52, 80)
local ACCENT = Color3.fromRGB(215, 170, 70)
local GREEN = Color3.fromRGB(150, 255, 180)
local RED = Color3.fromRGB(255, 130, 150)
local NEUTRAL = Color3.fromRGB(220, 210, 190)

--------------------------------------------------------------------
-- GUI
--------------------------------------------------------------------
local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
gui.Name = "MahoragaHub"
gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
gui.ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling
gui.Parent = guiParent

local frame = Instance.new("Frame")
frame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 280, 0, 372)
frame.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -140, 0.5, -186)
frame.BackgroundColor3 = BG
frame.BorderSizePixel = 0
frame.Parent = gui
Instance.new("UICorner", frame).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 12)

local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke", frame)
stroke.Color = ACCENT
stroke.Thickness = 2

local titleBar = Instance.new("Frame")
titleBar.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 38)
titleBar.BackgroundColor3 = BAR
titleBar.BorderSizePixel = 0
titleBar.Parent = frame
Instance.new("UICorner", titleBar).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 12)

local titleFix = Instance.new("Frame")
titleFix.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 12)
titleFix.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, -12)
titleFix.BackgroundColor3 = BAR
titleFix.BorderSizePixel = 0
titleFix.Parent = titleBar

local titleLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
titleLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, -50, 1, 0)
titleLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0, 12, 0, 0)
titleLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
titleLabel.Text = "☸ mahoraga hub"
titleLabel.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
titleLabel.TextSize = 16
titleLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
titleLabel.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
titleLabel.Parent = titleBar

local closeBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
closeBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 28, 0, 28)
closeBtn.Position = UDim2.new(1, -34, 0, 5)
closeBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 60, 90)
closeBtn.Text = "X"
closeBtn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
closeBtn.TextSize = 14
closeBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
closeBtn.Parent = titleBar
Instance.new("UICorner", closeBtn).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)

local function makeButton(text, y, color)
    local b = Instance.new("TextButton")
    b.Size = UDim2.new(1, -24, 0, 34)
    b.Position = UDim2.new(0, 12, 0, y)
    b.BackgroundColor3 = color or BTN
    b.Text = text
    b.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    b.TextSize = 13
    b.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
    b.Parent = frame
    Instance.new("UICorner", b).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
    return b
end

local spawnBtn = makeButton("⚔ Spawn", 50, Color3.fromRGB(150, 105, 35))
local activeBtn = makeButton("⚡ Ativo: ON", 92, Color3.fromRGB(70, 150, 110))
local attackBtn = makeButton("🗡 Ataque: ON", 134, Color3.fromRGB(170, 70, 80))
local climbBtn = makeButton("⬆ Subir na cabeça", 176)
local descBtn = makeButton("⬇ Descer", 218)
local removeBtn = makeButton("🗑 Remover", 260, Color3.fromRGB(110, 60, 60))

local status = Instance.new("TextLabel")
status.Size = UDim2.new(1, -24, 0, 66)
status.Position = UDim2.new(0, 12, 0, 302)
status.BackgroundTransparency = 1
status.Text = "Clique em Spawn para invocar o Mahoraga."
status.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
status.TextSize = 12
status.TextWrapped = true
status.TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Top
status.TextColor3 = NEUTRAL
status.Parent = frame

local function setStatus(text, color)
    status.Text = text
    status.TextColor3 = color or NEUTRAL
end

-- Arrastar
do
    local dragging, dragStart, startPos
    titleBar.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
            or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
            dragging = true
            dragStart = input.Position
            startPos = frame.Position
            input.Changed:Connect(function()
                if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then
                    dragging = false
                end
            end)
        end
    end)
    table.insert(connections, UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
        if dragging and (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
            or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
            local delta = input.Position - dragStart
            frame.Position = UDim2.new(
                startPos.X.Scale, startPos.X.Offset + delta.X,
                startPos.Y.Scale, startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y
            )
        end
    end))
end

--------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Helpers
--------------------------------------------------------------------
local function flat(v) return Vector3.new(v.X, 0, v.Z) end

local function getPlayerParts()
    local char = LocalPlayer.Character
    local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    return char, hrp, hum
end

local function ignoreList()
    local list = {}
    for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if p.Character then table.insert(list, p.Character) end
    end
    if mah then table.insert(list, mah.model) end
    return list
end

local function groundY(pos)
    local params = RaycastParams.new()
    params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
    params.FilterDescendantsInstances = ignoreList()
    local r = Workspace:Raycast(pos + Vector3.new(0, 40, 0), Vector3.new(0, -250, 0), params)
    return r and r.Position.Y
end

--------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Construção do Mahoraga
--------------------------------------------------------------------
local function newPart(parent, name, size, color, material, collide)
    local p = Instance.new("Part")
    p.Name = name
    p.Size = size
    p.Color = color
    p.Material = material or Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
    p.Anchored = false
    p.CanCollide = (collide ~= false)
    p.Massless = true
    p.TopSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
    p.BottomSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
    p.Parent = parent
    return p
end

local function joint(name, part0, part1, c0, c1)
    local m = Instance.new("Motor6D")
    m.Name = name
    m.Part0 = part0
    m.Part1 = part1
    m.C0 = c0 or CFrame.new()
    m.C1 = c1 or CFrame.new()
    m.Parent = part0
    return m
end

local function buildMahoraga(spawnCF)
    local model = Instance.new("Model")
    model.Name = "Mahoraga"

    local SKIN = Color3.fromRGB(224, 220, 210)
    local SKIN_LIGHT = Color3.fromRGB(240, 237, 228)
    local SKIN_SHADE = Color3.fromRGB(184, 180, 172)
    local DARK = Color3.fromRGB(26, 24, 32)
    local CLOTH = Color3.fromRGB(52, 38, 70)
    local GOLD = Color3.fromRGB(236, 198, 98)
    local STEEL = Color3.fromRGB(208, 213, 224)
    local STEEL_DARK = Color3.fromRGB(120, 126, 142)
    local ROPE = Color3.fromRGB(214, 198, 150)
    local MARBLE = Enum.Material.Marble
    local FABRIC = Enum.Material.Fabric
    local METAL = Enum.Material.Metal
    local NEON = Enum.Material.Neon
    local V3, CF, ANG = Vector3.new, CFrame.new, CFrame.Angles

    -- Pelvis (raiz, ancorada)
    local root = newPart(model, "Pelvis", V3(4.6, 2, 2.8), DARK, FABRIC)
    root.Anchored = true
    model.PrimaryPart = root

    -- Peças principais (as invisíveis servem só de colisão/junta)
    local torso = newPart(model, "Torso", V3(6.4, 6.5, 3.2), SKIN, MARBLE)
    local head = newPart(model, "Head", V3(4, 3.6, 4), SKIN, MARBLE)
    local legL = newPart(model, "LegL", V3(2.6, 7, 2.6), SKIN)
    local legR = newPart(model, "LegR", V3(2.6, 7, 2.6), SKIN)
    local armLU = newPart(model, "ArmLU", V3(2.2, 4.6, 2.2), SKIN)
    local armLL = newPart(model, "ArmLL", V3(1.9, 4.2, 1.9), SKIN)
    local armRU = newPart(model, "ArmRU", V3(2.2, 4.6, 2.2), SKIN)
    local armRL = newPart(model, "ArmRL", V3(2, 3.2, 2), DARK)
    local blade = newPart(model, "Blade", V3(0.8, 6.3, 2.6), STEEL, METAL)
    for _, p in ipairs({ legL, legR, armLU, armLL, armRU, armRL }) do
        p.Transparency = 1
    end

    local J, base = {}, {}
    local function reg(key, j) J[key] = j base[key] = j.C0 end

    reg("torso", joint("Torso", root, torso, CF(0, 4.25, 0)))
    reg("head", joint("Head", torso, head, CF(0, 5.05, 0)))
    reg("hipL", joint("HipL", root, legL, CF(-1.7, -1, 0), CF(0, 3.5, 0)))
    reg("hipR", joint("HipR", root, legR, CF(1.7, -1, 0), CF(0, 3.5, 0)))
    reg("shoL", joint("ShoulderL", torso, armLU, CF(-4.3, 2.6, 0), CF(0, 2.3, 0)))
    reg("shoR", joint("ShoulderR", torso, armRU, CF(4.3, 2.6, 0), CF(0, 2.3, 0)))
    reg("elbL", joint("ElbowL", armLU, armLL, CF(0, -2.3, 0), CF(0, 2.1, 0)))
    reg("elbR", joint("ElbowR", armRU, armRL, CF(0, -2.3, 0), CF(0, 1.6, 0)))
    reg("blade", joint("Blade", armRL, blade, CF(0, -1.6, 0), CF(0, 3.15, 0)))

    -- Helpers de detalhes (sem colisão)
    local function decor(name, parent, size, color, cf, material, shape)
        local p = newPart(model, name, size, color, material, false)
        p.CanQuery = false
        if shape then p.Shape = shape end
        joint(name, parent, p, cf)
        return p
    end
    local function ball(name, parent, d, color, cf, material)
        return decor(name, parent, V3(d, d, d), color, cf, material, Enum.PartType.Ball)
    end
    -- cilindro com o comprimento no eixo Y do pai
    local function cyl(name, parent, length, diameter, color, cf, material)
        local p = newPart(model, name, V3(length, diameter, diameter), color, material, false)
        p.CanQuery = false
        p.Shape = Enum.PartType.Cylinder
        joint(name, parent, p, cf * ANG(0, 0, math.pi / 2))
        return p
    end

    ----------------------------------------------------------------
    -- Pelvis / tanga
    ----------------------------------------------------------------
    decor("Belt", root, V3(4.9, 0.7, 3.1), GOLD, CF(0, 0.6, 0), METAL)
    decor("LoinFront", root, V3(3.4, 5.2, 0.35), CLOTH, CF(0, -3.2, -1.55), FABRIC)
    decor("LoinBack", root, V3(3.4, 5.2, 0.35), CLOTH, CF(0, -3.2, 1.55), FABRIC)
    decor("LoinTrimF", root, V3(3.5, 0.3, 0.45), GOLD, CF(0, -5.7, -1.55), METAL)
    decor("LoinTrimB", root, V3(3.5, 0.3, 0.45), GOLD, CF(0, -5.7, 1.55), METAL)

    ----------------------------------------------------------------
    -- Torso: peitoral, abdômen, corda, capa e ombros
    ----------------------------------------------------------------
    decor("PecL", torso, V3(2.9, 2.1, 0.8), SKIN_LIGHT, CF(-1.6, 1.9, -1.7), MARBLE)
    decor("PecR", torso, V3(2.9, 2.1, 0.8), SKIN_LIGHT, CF(1.6, 1.9, -1.7), MARBLE)
    for r = 0, 2 do
        for _, s in ipairs({ -1, 1 }) do
            decor("Abs", torso, V3(1.5, 0.95, 0.6), SKIN_LIGHT,
                CF(s * 0.85, 0.45 - r * 1.1, -1.65), MARBLE)
        end
    end
    decor("Sash", torso, V3(0.8, 8.2, 0.7), ROPE, CF(0, 0.3, -1.85) * ANG(0, 0, 0.65), FABRIC)
    decor("Cape", torso, V3(5.2, 9.6, 0.3), CLOTH, CF(0, -2.4, 1.85), FABRIC)
    decor("CapeTrim", torso, V3(5.3, 0.35, 0.4), GOLD, CF(0, -7.2, 1.85), METAL)
    cyl("Collar", torso, 0.5, 3.4, GOLD, CF(0, 3.3, 0), METAL)

    for _, s in ipairs({ -1, 1 }) do
        ball("ShoulderBall", torso, 3.9, SKIN, CF(s * 4.3, 2.7, 0), MARBLE)
        decor("Pauldron", torso, V3(4.0, 0.9, 4.2), DARK, CF(s * 4.3, 4.1, 0), FABRIC)
        decor("PauldronRim", torso, V3(4.2, 0.25, 4.4), GOLD, CF(s * 4.3, 4.6, 0), METAL)
    end

    ----------------------------------------------------------------
    -- Cabeça: expressão severa, olhos pálidos e protetor de mandíbula
    ----------------------------------------------------------------
    decor("Crown", head, V3(4.3, 0.5, 4.3), DARK, CF(0, 1.4, 0), FABRIC)
    decor("CrownTrim", head, V3(4.35, 0.14, 4.35), GOLD, CF(0, 1.05, 0), METAL)
    decor("Brow", head, V3(4.2, 0.6, 0.8), SKIN_SHADE, CF(0, 0.55, -1.85), MARBLE)
    for _, s in ipairs({ -1, 1 }) do
        decor("EyeSocket", head, V3(1.0, 0.5, 0.15), DARK, CF(s * 0.95, 0, -2.02))
        decor("Eye", head, V3(0.55, 0.18, 0.08), Color3.fromRGB(255, 235, 170),
            CF(s * 0.95, 0, -2.1), NEON)
        decor("Ear", head, V3(0.5, 1.4, 1.0), SKIN_SHADE, CF(s * 2.2, 0, 0), MARBLE)
    end
    decor("Nose", head, V3(0.7, 1.5, 0.9), SKIN_SHADE, CF(0, -0.5, -2.15) * ANG(-0.25, 0, 0), MARBLE)
    decor("Jaw", head, V3(3.6, 1.3, 0.5), DARK, CF(0, -1.2, -2.05), FABRIC)
    for i = -2, 2 do
        decor("JawLine", head, V3(0.12, 1.1, 0.1), SKIN, CF(i * 0.6, -1.2, -2.33))
    end

    ----------------------------------------------------------------
    -- Pernas
    ----------------------------------------------------------------
    for _, leg in ipairs({ legL, legR }) do
        cyl("Thigh", leg, 3.8, 3.1, SKIN, CF(0, 1.5, 0), MARBLE)
        ball("Knee", leg, 2.5, SKIN_LIGHT, CF(0, -0.4, -0.1), MARBLE)
        cyl("Shin", leg, 3.4, 2.5, SKIN, CF(0, -1.9, 0), MARBLE)
        cyl("ShinWrap", leg, 0.9, 2.85, DARK, CF(0, -2.8, 0), FABRIC)
        cyl("ShinWrap", leg, 0.5, 2.8, CLOTH, CF(0, -1.6, 0), FABRIC)
        decor("Foot", leg, V3(2.9, 1, 4.0), DARK, CF(0, -3.0, -0.6), FABRIC)
        decor("ToeCap", leg, V3(2.9, 0.6, 0.8), GOLD, CF(0, -2.9, -2.4), METAL)
    end

    ----------------------------------------------------------------
    -- Braço esquerdo
    ----------------------------------------------------------------
    cyl("BicepL", armLU, 4.2, 2.8, SKIN, CF(0, 0, 0), MARBLE)
    cyl("ArmbandL", armLU, 0.5, 3.05, GOLD, CF(0, -0.9, 0), METAL)
    cyl("ForearmL", armLL, 3.8, 2.3, SKIN, CF(0, 0, 0), MARBLE)
    cyl("WristWrapL", armLL, 1.4, 2.55, DARK, CF(0, -0.8, 0), FABRIC)
    ball("HandL", armLL, 2.4, SKIN, CF(0, -2.7, 0), MARBLE)
    for i = 1, 4 do
        decor("FingerL", armLL, V3(0.4, 1.1, 0.45), SKIN_SHADE, CF(-0.75 + (i - 1) * 0.5, -3.6, -0.2), MARBLE)
    end

    ----------------------------------------------------------------
    -- Braço direito + Espada da Extermínio
    ----------------------------------------------------------------
    cyl("BicepR", armRU, 4.2, 3.0, SKIN, CF(0, 0, 0), MARBLE)
    cyl("ArmbandR", armRU, 0.5, 3.25, GOLD, CF(0, -0.9, 0), METAL)
    cyl("BracerR", armRL, 3.2, 2.7, DARK, CF(0, 0, 0), FABRIC)
    cyl("BracerRingA", armRL, 0.4, 2.95, GOLD, CF(0, 0.9, 0), METAL)
    cyl("BracerRingB", armRL, 0.4, 2.95, GOLD, CF(0, -1.0, 0), METAL)
    cyl("Hilt", armRL, 1.2, 1.5, ROPE, CF(0, -1.9, 0), FABRIC)
    decor("Guard", armRL, V3(1.3, 0.5, 4.0), GOLD, CF(0, -2.5, 0), METAL)

    decor("BladeRidge", blade, V3(0.95, 5.4, 0.5), STEEL_DARK, CF(0, 0.2, 0.55), METAL)
    decor("BladeEdge", blade, V3(0.35, 5.6, 0.12), Color3.fromRGB(255, 250, 230), CF(0, -0.2, -1.28), NEON)
    decor("BladeTip", blade, V3(0.8, 1.84, 1.84), STEEL, CF(0, -3.15, 0) * ANG(math.pi / 4, 0, 0), METAL)
    for i = 1, 4 do
        decor("BladeTooth", blade, V3(0.6, 0.9, 0.9), STEEL,
            CF(0, 1.9 - (i - 1) * 1.1, -1.3) * ANG(math.pi / 4, 0, 0), METAL)
    end

    ----------------------------------------------------------------
    -- Roda de Dharma sobre a cabeça (gira) + brilho dourado
    ----------------------------------------------------------------
    local wheelCore = newPart(model, "WheelCore", V3(0.4, 0.4, 0.4), GOLD, NEON, false)
    wheelCore.Transparency = 1
    wheelCore.CanQuery = false
    reg("wheel", joint("Wheel", head, wheelCore, CF(0, 3.4, 0)))

    local glow = Instance.new("PointLight")
    glow.Color = GOLD
    glow.Brightness = 2
    glow.Range = 20
    glow.Parent = wheelCore

    local R, R2, N = 3.9, 3.0, 24
    for i = 1, N do
        local a = (i / N) * math.pi * 2
        decor("WheelRing", wheelCore, V3(1.2, 0.5, 0.6), GOLD,
            CF(R * math.cos(a), 0, R * math.sin(a)) * ANG(0, -(a + math.pi / 2), 0), NEON)
        decor("WheelInner", wheelCore, V3(1.0, 0.3, 0.3), GOLD,
            CF(R2 * math.cos(a), 0, R2 * math.sin(a)) * ANG(0, -(a + math.pi / 2), 0), NEON)
    end
    for i = 1, 8 do
        local a = (i / 8) * math.pi * 2
        decor("WheelHandle", wheelCore, V3(2.6, 0.4, 0.4), GOLD,
            CF((R + 1.1) * math.cos(a), 0, (R + 1.1) * math.sin(a)) * ANG(0, -a, 0), NEON)
        ball("WheelPommel", wheelCore, 0.9, GOLD,
            CF((R + 2.4) * math.cos(a), 0, (R + 2.4) * math.sin(a)), NEON)
    end

    model:PivotTo(spawnCF)

    return {
        model = model, root = root, head = head, blade = blade,
        J = J, base = base,
        facing = spawnCF.LookVector * Vector3.new(1, 0, 1),
        phase = 0, amp = 0, wheelAngle = 0,
        swing = nil, lastSwing = 0,
        wanderTarget = nil, wanderWait = 1,
        graceUntil = os.clock() + GRACE_SECONDS,
    }
end

--------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Detecção de "em cima da cabeça"
--------------------------------------------------------------------
local function isRiding(char, hrp)
    if not mah or not char or not hrp then return false end
    local params = RaycastParams.new()
    params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
    params.FilterDescendantsInstances = { char }
    local r = Workspace:Raycast(hrp.Position, Vector3.new(0, -7, 0), params)
    return r ~= nil
        and r.Instance:IsDescendantOf(mah.model)
        and r.Position.Y > mah.root.Position.Y + 7
end

--------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Golpe
--------------------------------------------------------------------
local REST_ARM = 0.35
local function swingAngle(t)
    if t < 0.45 then
        return REST_ARM + (-2.4 - REST_ARM) * (t / 0.45)
    elseif t < 0.65 then
        return -2.4 + (1.3 + 2.4) * ((t - 0.45) / 0.2)
    else
        local a = math.min((t - 0.65) / 0.35, 1)
        return 1.3 + (REST_ARM - 1.3) * a
    end
end

--------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Loop principal
--------------------------------------------------------------------
local function step(dt)
    local m = mah
    if not m or not m.model.Parent then return end

    local root = m.root
    local char, hrp, hum = getPlayerParts()
    local alive = hrp ~= nil and hum ~= nil and hum.Health > 0
    local riding = alive and isRiding(char, hrp) or false

    local oldCF = root.CFrame
    local pos = oldCF.Position
    local newPos = pos
    local desiredDir = nil
    local speed = 0
    local now = os.clock()

    if isActive then
        local playerDist = alive and flat(hrp.Position - pos).Magnitude or nil

        if m.swing then
            -- atacando: fica parado olhando para você
            if alive then desiredDir = flat(hrp.Position - pos) end
            m.swing.t += dt
            if m.swing.t >= 0.55 and not m.swing.checked then
                m.swing.checked = true
                if isAggressive and alive and not riding then
                    local d = flat(hrp.Position - root.Position).Magnitude
                    local dy = math.abs(hrp.Position.Y - root.Position.Y)
                    if d < REACH and dy < 16 then
                        hum.Health = 0
                    end
                end
            end
            if m.swing.t >= 1 then
                m.swing = nil
                m.lastSwing = now
            end
        elseif isAggressive and playerDist and playerDist < AGGRO_RANGE and not riding then
            -- perseguir
            desiredDir = flat(hrp.Position - pos)
            if playerDist > 10 then
                speed = SPEED_CHASE
            end
            if playerDist < ATTACK_START and now > m.graceUntil and now - m.lastSwing > SWING_COOLDOWN then
                m.swing = { t = 0, checked = false }
            end
        else
            -- passear
            if m.wanderTarget then
                local toT = flat(m.wanderTarget - pos)
                if toT.Magnitude < 3 then
                    m.wanderTarget = nil
                    m.wanderWait = 1 + math.random() * 2.5
                else
                    desiredDir = toT
                    speed = SPEED_WANDER
                end
            else
                m.wanderWait -= dt
                if m.wanderWait <= 0 then
                    local ang = math.random() * math.pi * 2
                    local dist = 25 + math.random() * 30
                    m.wanderTarget = pos + Vector3.new(math.cos(ang) * dist, 0, math.sin(ang) * dist)
                end
            end
        end
    else
        m.swing = nil
    end

    -- Direção / movimento
    if desiredDir and desiredDir.Magnitude > 0.01 then
        local d = desiredDir.Unit
        local f = m.facing + (d - m.facing) * math.min(1, dt * 5)
        if f.Magnitude > 0.01 then m.facing = f.Unit end
    end
    if speed > 0 then
        newPos = pos + m.facing * speed * dt
    end

    -- Altura (segue o chão)
    local gy = groundY(newPos)
    local targetY = gy and (gy + 8) or pos.Y
    local newY = pos.Y + (targetY - pos.Y) * math.min(1, dt * 8)
    local finalPos = Vector3.new(newPos.X, newY, newPos.Z)
    local newCF = CFrame.lookAt(finalPos, finalPos + m.facing)
    root.CFrame = newCF

    -- Carrega quem está em cima da cabeça
    if riding then
        hrp.CFrame = (newCF * oldCF:Inverse()) * hrp.CFrame
    end

    -- Animação
    local moving = speed > 0
    if moving then m.phase += dt * speed * 0.35 end
    m.amp += ((moving and 0.6 or 0) - m.amp) * math.min(1, dt * 8)
    if isActive then
        m.wheelAngle += dt * (m.swing and 8 or 1.5)
    end

    local J, B = m.J, m.base
    local s = math.sin(m.phase)
    J.hipL.C0 = B.hipL * CFrame.Angles(s * m.amp, 0, 0)
    J.hipR.C0 = B.hipR * CFrame.Angles(-s * m.amp, 0, 0)
    J.shoL.C0 = B.shoL * CFrame.Angles(-s * m.amp * 0.6 + 0.1, 0, 0)
    local armR = m.swing and swingAngle(m.swing.t) or (REST_ARM + s * m.amp * 0.4)
    J.shoR.C0 = B.shoR * CFrame.Angles(armR, 0, 0)
    J.elbR.C0 = B.elbR * CFrame.Angles(0.15, 0, 0)
    J.torso.C0 = B.torso * CFrame.new(0, math.sin(now * 2) * 0.12 + math.abs(s) * m.amp * 0.25, 0)
    J.wheel.C0 = B.wheel * CFrame.Angles(0, m.wheelAngle, 0)
end

table.insert(connections, RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(step))

--------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Ações dos botões
--------------------------------------------------------------------
local function doSpawn()
    if mah then
        setStatus("Já existe um Mahoraga. Remova ele antes de invocar outro.", RED)
        return
    end
    local _, hrp = getPlayerParts()
    if not hrp then
        setStatus("Seu personagem ainda não carregou.", RED)
        return
    end

    local pos = hrp.Position + hrp.CFrame.LookVector * 35
    local gy = groundY(pos)
    local y = (gy or (hrp.Position.Y - 3)) + 8
    local spawnPos = Vector3.new(pos.X, y, pos.Z)
    local lookAt = Vector3.new(hrp.Position.X, y, hrp.Position.Z)

    mah = buildMahoraga(CFrame.lookAt(spawnPos, lookAt))
    mah.model.Parent = Workspace
    setStatus("Mahoraga invocado! Você tem alguns segundos antes dele atacar.", GREEN)
end

local function doRemove()
    if not mah then
        setStatus("Não existe Mahoraga para remover.", RED)
        return
    end
    mah.model:Destroy()
    mah = nil
    setStatus("Mahoraga removido.", NEUTRAL)
end

local function doClimb()
    if not mah then setStatus("Invoque o Mahoraga primeiro.", RED) return end
    local _, hrp = getPlayerParts()
    if not hrp then return end
    hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
    hrp.CFrame = mah.head.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 1.8 + 3.5, 0)
    setStatus("Você está na cabeça dele. Ande por ela e vá junto com ele!", GREEN)
end

local function doDescend()
    if not mah then setStatus("Invoque o Mahoraga primeiro.", RED) return end
    local _, hrp = getPlayerParts()
    if not hrp then return end
    local side = (mah.root.CFrame * CFrame.new(12, 0, 0)).Position
    local gy = groundY(side)
    hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
    hrp.CFrame = CFrame.new(side.X, (gy or side.Y - 8) + 4, side.Z)
    setStatus("Você desceu.", NEUTRAL)
end

spawnBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(doSpawn)
removeBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(doRemove)
climbBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(doClimb)

activeBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    isActive = not isActive

    setStatus(isActive and "Mahoraga ativado." or "Mahoraga desativado (parado e inofensivo).", NEUTRAL)

attackBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()

scripts.summary: Teleports to game that u inserted ( need game ID )
scripts.code:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local TeleportService = game:GetService("TeleportService")

local player = Players.LocalPlayer

-- GUI
local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
gui.Name = "GameTeleport"
gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
gui.Parent = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

local frame = Instance.new("Frame")
frame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 300, 0, 160)
frame.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -150, 0.5, -80)
frame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(25, 25, 30)
frame.Parent = gui

local input = Instance.new("TextBox")
input.Size = UDim2.new(0, 260, 0, 40)
input.Position = UDim2.new(0, 20, 0, 20)
input.PlaceholderText = "Enter Game ID (PlaceId)"
input.Text = ""
input.Parent = frame

local button = Instance.new("TextButton")
button.Size = UDim2.new(0, 260, 0, 40)
button.Position = UDim2.new(0, 20, 0, 80)
button.Text = "JOIN GAME"
button.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40, 130, 220)
button.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
button.Parent = frame

button.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    local gameId = tonumber(input.Text)

    if not gameId or gameId <= 0 or gameId % 1 ~= 0 then
        button.Text = "Invalid Game ID!"
        return
    end

    button.Text = "Teleporting..."

    local success, err = pcall(function()
        TeleportService:Teleport(gameId, player)
    end)

    if not success then
        button.Text = "Teleport failed!"
        warn(err)
    end
end)

scripts.code:
local Rayfield = loadstring(game:HttpGet('https://sirius.menu/rayfield'))()
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local VirtualUser = game:GetService("VirtualUser")
local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer

local Window = Rayfield:CreateWindow({
   Name = "Silent Assassin Ultimate",
   LoadingTitle = "Loading Exploits...",
   ConfigurationSaving = {Enabled = false},
   KeySystem = false
})

local visualTab = Window:CreateTab("Visuals & Combat", nil)
local hitboxTab = Window:CreateTab("Hitbox", nil)

-- ==========================================
-- STATE VARIABLES
-- ==========================================
local State = {
    ESP = false,
    AutoSlice = false,
    HitboxMode = "All", -- "All" or "Specific"
    SpecificTarget = nil,
    HitboxSize = 1,
    HitboxEnabled = false,
    Highlights = {},
    OriginalSizes = {}
}

-- ==========================================
-- 1. VISUALS & ESP
-- ==========================================
visualTab:CreateToggle({
   Name = "Force Visible (ESP)",
   CurrentValue = false,
   Flag = "ESP",
   Callback = function(Value)
       State.ESP = Value
       if not Value then
           -- Clean up highlights
           for p, hl in pairs(State.Highlights) do
               if hl then hl:Destroy() end
           end
           State.Highlights = {}
       end
   end,
})

visualTab:CreateToggle({
   Name = "Auto-Slice (Aim & Swing)",
   CurrentValue = false,
   Flag = "AutoSlice",
   Callback = function(Value)
       State.AutoSlice = Value
   end,
})

-- ==========================================
-- 2. HITBOX EXPANDER
-- ==========================================
local playerNames = {"All"}
for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
    if p ~= LocalPlayer then table.insert(playerNames, p.Name) end
end

hitboxTab:CreateDropdown({
   Name = "Hitbox Target Mode",
   Options = {"All", "Specific"},
   CurrentOption = {"All"},
   MultipleOptions = false,
   Flag = "HitboxMode",
   Callback = function(Options)
       State.HitboxMode = Options[1]
   end,
})

hitboxTab:CreateDropdown({
   Name = "Specific Player",
   Options = playerNames,
   CurrentOption = {},
   MultipleOptions = false,
   Flag = "SpecificTarget",
   Callback = function(Options)
       State.SpecificTarget = Players:FindFirstChild(Options[1])
   end,
})

hitboxTab:CreateSlider({
   Name = "Hitbox Size (Max 500)",
   Range = {1, 500}, 
   Increment = 1,
   Suffix = "studs",
   CurrentValue = 1,
   Flag = "HitboxSize",
   Callback = function(Value)
       State.HitboxSize = Value
   end,
})

hitboxTab:CreateToggle({
   Name = "Enable Hitbox Expander",
   CurrentValue = false,
   Flag = "HitboxEnabled",
   Callback = function(Value)
       State.HitboxEnabled = Value
       if not Value then
           -- Reset sizes
           for char, size in pairs(State.OriginalSizes) do
               local hrp = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
               if hrp then
                   hrp.Size = size
                   hrp.Transparency = 1
                   hrp.CanCollide = true
                   hrp.Material = Enum.Material.Plastic
               end
           end
           State.OriginalSizes = {}
       end
   end,
})

-- ==========================================
-- 3. MAIN LOOP (Runs 10 times a second)
-- ==========================================
task.spawn(function()
    while task.wait(0.1) do
        
        local myChar = LocalPlayer.Character
        local myHRP = myChar and myChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

        -- 1. ESP LOGIC
        if State.ESP then
            for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
                if p ~= LocalPlayer and p.Character then
                    -- Force visible
                    for _, part in ipairs(p.Character:GetDescendants()) do
                        if part:IsA("BasePart") and part.Name ~= "HumanoidRootPart" then
                            part.LocalTransparencyModifier = 0
                        end
                    end
                    -- Add highlight
                    if not State.Highlights[p] or not State.Highlights[p].Parent then
                        local hl = Instance.new("Highlight")
                        hl.Adornee = p.Character
                        hl.FillColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0)
                        hl.OutlineColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
                        hl.FillTransparency = 0.5
                        hl.DepthMode = Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop
                        hl.Parent = p.Character
                        State.Highlights[p] = hl
                    end
                end
            end
        end

        -- 2. HITBOX LOGIC
        if State.HitboxEnabled then
            for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
                if p ~= LocalPlayer and p.Character then
                    local applyHitbox = false
                    
                    if State.HitboxMode == "All" then
                        applyHitbox = true
                    elseif State.HitboxMode == "Specific" and p == State.SpecificTarget then
                        applyHitbox = true
                    end

                    if applyHitbox then
                        local hrp = p.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                        if hrp then
                            if not State.OriginalSizes[p.Character] then
                                State.OriginalSizes[p.Character] = hrp.Size
                            end
                            hrp.Size = Vector3.new(State.HitboxSize, State.HitboxSize, State.HitboxSize)
                            hrp.Transparency = 0.5
                            hrp.CanCollide = false
                            hrp.BrickColor = BrickColor.new("Really red")
                            hrp.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end

        -- 3. AUTO-SLICE LOGIC
        if State.AutoSlice and myHRP then
            local targetToHit = nil
            local shortestDist = 20 -- Slice range

            for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
                if p ~= LocalPlayer and p.Character and p.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
                    local canHit = false
                    if State.HitboxMode == "All" then
                        canHit = true
                    elseif State.HitboxMode == "Specific" and p == State.SpecificTarget then
                        canHit = true
                    end

                    if canHit then
                        local dist = (myHRP.Position - p.Character.HumanoidRootPart.Position).Magnitude
                        if dist < shortestDist then
                            shortestDist = dist
                            targetToHit = p.Character
                        end
                    end
                end
            end

            if targetToHit then
                -- Snap to target
                myHRP.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(myHRP.Position, targetToHit.HumanoidRootPart.Position)
                
                -- Simulate Mouse Click
                VirtualUser:CaptureController()
                VirtualUser:ClickButton1(Vector2.new(0,0))
                
                -- Activate equipped tool (Knife/Sword)
                local tool = myChar:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Tool")
                if tool then
                    pcall(function() tool:Activate() end)
                end
            end
        end
    end
end)

-- Refresh player list cleanly if someone leaves
Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
    if player == State.SpecificTarget then
        State.SpecificTarget = nil
    end
end)

print("✅ Silent Assassin Ultimate Loaded.")
